races.race_name: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race

runners.name: Bill Silvers
runners.spotlight: Best run for this yard was when runner-up over 1m1f in a Leopardstown handicap last summer (soft); lost form after that and was well beaten on his seasonal return last month at Leopardstown; visor goes on and has been given a chance at the weightings but you'd like to see more positive recent form.
runners.comment: Given a chance at these weightings but you'd like to see more positive recent form

runners.name: Mythical Rock
runners.spotlight: AW winner in January has run some good races in defeat for this yard; second at Limerick in June (1m, yielding) but her run over C&D two days later probably came too soon; another promising effort at Killarney last time when defeated by a head (1m, good); wears a first-time visor; chance.
runners.comment: AW winner has run good races in defeat for new yard this term; chance

runners.name: Minaun View
runners.spotlight: Landed back-to-back 1m claimers at Bellewstown and Killarney in July when beating a few of these; couldn't do three in a row at Ballinrobe when third; didn't transfer that form to handicaps at Galway last time; dangerous in these races though; drawn wide.
runners.comment: Back-to-back claimer winner in July; didn't transfer that to h'caps at Galway; dangerous

runners.name: Land Of The Giants
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at Ayr in May when landing a 1m1f handicap off 63; some decent runs since, most notably when 1l behind Minaun View in a Ballinrobe claimer in July; finished further behind that rival at Killarney next time and posted a moderate effort in a Naas handicap latest.
runners.comment: Off the mark in an Ayr h'cap in May; form has dipped a little in latest two runs

runners.name: Liberate
runners.spotlight: Won a Goodwood novice for James Horton; not beaten far at the Curragh over 1m on penultimate but her run at Galway (1m1f, yielding) was a step backwards when drawn wide; not ruled out from a good draw.
runners.comment: Novice winner last term; decent effort on penultimate; not ruled out

runners.name: Hello Stacia
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in third on her Limerick debut; some improvement over C&D next time when seventh of 13; comes up against more experienced types now but unexposed; wide draw.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on debut; a bit better over C&D next time; up against experienced types

runners.name: Buttermere Ridge
runners.spotlight: 1-11 on Flat after landing a 7f course maiden in April 2024; just 1.5l behind Minaun View in a Bellewstown claimer in July (1m, good) and better off at weights now; well beaten at Galway latest (7f, yielding).
runners.comment: Course winner wasn't far behind Minaun View on penultimate and better off at weights now

runners.name: Contrite
runners.spotlight: Ran with credit on her AW debut when fourth behind a decent type; reportedly failed to handle soft conditions at Cork in May when tailed off (1m3f, soft); better effort at Ballinrobe last time when third, but it wasn't particularly progressive; cheekpieces are added to the tongue tie now but others are better weighted.
runners.comment: Good AW debut but hasn't progressed in two turf runs since; others better weighted

runners.name: Passage Of Power
runners.spotlight: Promising third of ten on AW debut in January (6f); returned from a break at Fairyhouse next time when a 16l fifth of 15 (7f, good), shaping like he would come on; drops into claimer company but he's not up for claiming so looks dangerous; wide draw to overcome, however.
runners.comment: Shaped like he would improve last time; looks dangerous dropping into this class

runners.name: Zitkala Sa
runners.spotlight: Shaped creditably on C&D handicap debut in June when third; below that in a Fairyhouse claimer last time (1m2f, good, 100-30); tongue tie worn that day is left off for her stable debut here.
runners.comment: Shaped creditably on C&D h'cap bow but below that in claimer latest; stable debut

runners.name: Jp's Express
runners.spotlight: Good third at Fairyhouse in early July and backed that up when winning at the Galway festival later in the month (1m1f, yielding to soft); couldn't back it up in similar contest under a 7lb penalty two days later but was a creditable fifth; others are better weighted but he's in form.
runners.comment: Others are better weighted but he's in good form considering his Galway festival win

runners.name: Macinamillion
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort has won a chase, over hurdles and on the Flat; soundly beaten in final start for Gavin Cromwell at Thurles (2m, good) in October and off since; best watched in first run for new yard.
runners.comment: Versatile sort is best watched in first start for new yard

runners.name: Countertop
runners.spotlight: Front-running fifth at 200-1 in a 9.5f Ballinrobe maiden on penutlimate looks like a bit of an aberration based on overall form; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Fifth at 200-1 in a m'den on penultimate looks like an aberration on overall form

runners.name: If Not For Grace
runners.spotlight: Beaten at triple-figure odds in two maiden runs to date; probably safe to rule out.
runners.comment: Beaten at triple-figure odds in two maiden runs to date; probably safe to rule out

runners.name: Slight Of Foot
runners.spotlight: First reserve; 0-7 and poor in two outings for this yard.
runners.comment: Reserve; 0-7 and poor in two outings for this yard.

runners.name: May Night
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner but hasn't scored since May 2024 and has been off since running well to finish third in a Ballinrobe claimer in July last year; record when fresh suggests he might need this.
runners.comment: Seven-time winner hasn't scored since May 2024; record suggests he may need this

runners.name: Hastily
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; four-time winner has run poorly in five starts this term; others more likely.
runners.comment: Reserve; four-time winner has run poorly in five starts this term; others more likely

races.race_name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Citrus Springs
runners.spotlight: Olympiad filly cost 300,000USD at Ocala in March; faded badly at Listowel on her debut (6.5f, good); improved to take second at Leopardstown next time, albeit no match for the winner; had the debuting Miss Twilight just a neck behind that day; the visor is reached for in the quest for more now; drawn wide.
runners.comment: Expensive 2yo improved over debut when second last time; visor goes on in quest for more

runners.name: Just One Show
runners.spotlight: Belied odds of 25-1 to run a massive race at Fairyhouse on debut (6f, good) on debut, finding one rival (who had the benefit of a run) too good; sent off the 2-1 favourite at Navan (6f, good) off the back of that but didn't find the expected improvement when fifth of 17; must carry top weight once again here.
runners.comment: Ran a massive race on debut when second at 25-1; didn't find improvement next time

runners.name: Not You Too
runners.spotlight: 125,000gns yearling chased home a 1-3 chance on her debut at Leopardstown (6.5f, good); she was 9l behind but it was a creditable effort all the same (This That 3.75l behind); should improve for that experience and is in the mix.
runners.comment: Chased home 1-3 chance on debut; should improve for that experience and in the mix

runners.name: Mirren
runners.spotlight: Outran odds of 66-1 on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good), keeping on nicely from the back for a 4l fifth of 12; was 3.5l behind third Sea Of Rain, who beat Citrus Springs by the same distance in a Leopardstown maiden next time; could go well from good draw.
runners.comment: Outran odds when a 4l fifth on debut and tied in form reads well; could go well

runners.name: Williamsburg
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; finished a 5l seventh of 12 on his debut at Leopardstown (7f, good, 40-1); others more likely.
runners.comment: Reserve; seventh of 12 on debut when 40-1; others preferred

runners.name: Battle Ready
runners.spotlight: Holy Roman Emperor colt; 3,000euros foal, 22,000euros yearling; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Shamastar (KSA 6f) and Albayaader (US 6.5f); dam unraced half-sister to 1m4f Group 3 winner Muntahaa, out of French 1m3f Listed winner; market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Improved in value to 22,000euros as yearling; half-brother to two winners; check market

runners.name: Dragon Scales
runners.spotlight: Footstepsinthesand filly; 25,000euros yearling; second foal; dam 6f-1m maiden (RPR 67), sister to 6f 2yo winner Ginbar, half-sister to 1m Listed winner Magical Dreamer, out of German 1m winner; market can sort trainer's two.
runners.comment: 25,000euros yearling; dam 6f-1m maiden (RPR 67); market can sort trainer's two

runners.name: Summer Sent You
runners.spotlight: 20,000euros yearling; first foal; dam German 1m1f winner, half-sister to winners Vif Monsieur (German 1m2f/1m4f Group 3), Vive Ma Fille (Listed-placed 1m4f) and Vision Clear (1m4f Flat/2m hurdle).
runners.comment: 20,000euros yearling; dam German 1m1f winner; check market

runners.name: Feel The Sting
runners.spotlight: Saxon Warrior colt; 10,000euros yearling; second foal; dam French 10.5f winner (RPR 98), sister to Japanese 6f winner Eternal Blaze, half-sister to 6f 2yo/1m winner Centre Court, out of French Group-placed 10.5f/1m4f winner; best watched for debut.
runners.comment: Saxon Warrior colt cost 10,000euros as a yearling; dam French winner; best watched

runners.name: Snapequus
runners.spotlight: Ten Sovereigns colt holds a Group 1 entry in September; 47,000GBP yearling; third foal; brother to 1m AW winner Snapaurum (RPR 89); dam 1m winner/Group 3 placed at 1m4f (102), half-sister to winners Snapraeterea (7f/7.5f Listed) and Pedisnap (7f/1m), out of 6.5f-1m1f winner; Browne McMonagle chooses the more experienced Citrus Springs.
runners.comment: Ten Sovereigns colt holds Gr.1 entry but McMonagle chooses the experienced Citrus Springs

runners.name: This That
runners.spotlight: Ran on late in his Leopardstown debut (6.5f, good) when within 3.75l of fellow debutant Not You Too; should come on for that outing and may turn around that form.
runners.comment: Ran on late in his debut when 3.75l behind Not You Too; should improve

runners.name: Shenata
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; glimmer of ability on her debut at Leopardstown (7f, good) when staying on into sixth; trainer has won two of last three runnings of this race.
runners.comment: Reserve; glimmer of ability on debut when staying on into sixth over this trip
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Rock On Johnny
runners.spotlight: Beat just one rival on his debut at Bellewstown over 1m; others more likely.
runners.comment: Beat just one rival on his debut at Bellewstown over 1m; others more likely

runners.name: Cudawudashuda
runners.spotlight: First reserve; quiet enough debut at Bellewstown when 10.5l behind the winner after being slowly away.
runners.comment: Reserve; quiet enough debut at Bellewstown when 10.5l behind the winner

runners.name: Arizonaneargalway
runners.spotlight: Lost ground at the start when tailed off at Leopardstown, but a bit better at Sligo; not of interest in this contest though.
runners.comment: Slightly better at Sligo but not of interest in this contest

runners.name: Stay Curious
runners.spotlight: Dwelt at start when never a factor on 7.5f Roscommon debut four weeks ago; didn't improve at Fairyhouse next time having been gelded; others preferred.
runners.comment: Never a factor in either m'den start; others preferred.

runners.name: Closefield Beau
runners.spotlight: 40-1 and faded after racing prominently on debut at Down Royal (7f, soft); may need more time.
runners.comment: 40-1 and faded after racing prominently on debut at Down Royal; may need more time

runners.name: Scotty Cameron
runners.spotlight: Has beaten very few rivals in two maidens; safe enough to rule out.
runners.comment: Has beaten very few rivals in two maidens; safe enough to rule out

races.race_name: FINAL FURLONG PODCAST WITH 1XBET Handicap

runners.name: Pretty Omagh Girl
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on seasonal return in a Curragh handicap (1m, good), making all in dominant fashion; hit hard for that with a 10lb rise and came up short in a premier handicap back at the Curragh latest (1m, good, 9-2); that run looked too bad to be true and was found to be coughing post-race; drops in trip but she's interesting if rebounding.
runners.comment: Dominant winner on seasonal return; excuses latest; interesting if rebounding

runners.name: Ohailbhic
runners.spotlight: In excellent form at Dundalk earlier this year; 0-9 on turf and moderate effort at Naas (6f, good) on return from 124 days off on latest; should strip fitter now and 7f more suitable so not totally discounted.
runners.comment: In excellent form on AW; 0-9 on turf but will be fitter for comeback; not discounted

runners.name: Indigo Dream
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner has to get her head in front on turf (0-11) but has run some fine races in defeat; not a bad effort when fourth at the Curragh in June (7f, good), 3l behind Little Empire; ran poorly in an added tongue tie (retained) at Fairyhouse last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: AW winner is 0-11 on turf but has run well at times; 3l behind Little Empire penultimately

runners.name: Lohoobb
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in all four handicap starts for Owen Burrows; okay stable debut at Naas (6f, good); never better than midfield at the Curragh on Sunday (6f, good to firm); this comes quick enough.
runners.comment: Beaten fav' in all four h'cap runs in Britain; midfield at Curragh on Sunday

runners.name: Little Empire
runners.spotlight: Both turf wins came on quick ground at 7f-1m at Ayr; posted a career best when only caught late on in a 17-runner 7f Curragh handicap in June when ahead of a few of these; her run at Naas next time was below that (7f, good) good claims on that Curragh effort.
runners.comment: Posted a career best when ahead of a few of these on penultimate; below that next time

runners.name: Alfred Tennyson
runners.spotlight: Carries a 7lb penalty due to his C&D victory five days ago; that win came following a good third at the Galway festival (7f, yielding) but he's not the most consistent overall, so not guaranteed to reproduce his winning form.
runners.comment: Carries penalty for C&D win five days ago; not the most consistent sort

runners.name: Exquisite Acclaim
runners.spotlight: Behind Indigo Dream and Little Empire at the Curragh in June (7f, good); good third at Fairyhouse next time (7f, good) but her form has taken a nosedive in two runs since then; needs to get back on track but the jockey booking is interesting.
runners.comment: Form has taken a nosedive in latest two runs but jockey booking is interesting
runners.owner: Thomas J O'Connor & Ms Hazel McGuinness

races.race_name: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Skydance
runners.spotlight: Highly tried last season, showing some pretty smart form when second in a Leopardstown Group 3 and when beaten under 4l in a Curragh Group 1; edged out subsequent Oaks winner Thundering On in her Leopardstown reappearance (1m, good to yielding); ran keenly in an Ascot Group 3 last month, but it was still a decent third; sets a good standard.
runners.comment: Beat subsequent Oaks winner in a m'den and decent third in Gr.3 latest; sets good standard

runners.name: Lemsairbat
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-14 for current yard but her form in Listed races this term is encouraging; finished second over C&D in May (0.5l in front of Subsonic); another positive third over 1m4f at Pontefract last time; the fact Browne McMonagle rides her ahead of Star Performer is a big boost to her chances.
runners.comment: 0-14 for current yard but positive Listed form this term; McMonagle chooses her
runners.owner: H R D McCalmont & Hamish McCalmont & Andrew N C Bengough

runners.name: Minerva
runners.spotlight: Frankel filly ran seven times at two, opening her account on the final start when odds-on in a 7f maiden at Leopardstown; made a poor seasonal return in a Navan Group 3 (1m2f, good to yielding) in April when sixth of seven and beaten 12l; her official rating looks a little flattering.
runners.comment: Ran seven times at two winning the final statt; poor seasonal return; OR flattering

runners.name: Moonlit Sun
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m Naas fillies' maiden at the second attempt despite showing signs of greenness (good); everything didn't go right at Galway (1m1f, yielding) on her handicap debut last time, so her close fourth there can be marked up; needs more at this level.
runners.comment: Won her m'den at the second attempt and creditable fourth in a h'cap latest; more needed

runners.name: Star Performer
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars filly was purchased for 160,000euros as a 2yo; impressed when winning on her Curragh debut last month (1m1f, good to firm), although it wasn't a strong contest; McDonogh remains aboard her and McMonagle rides Lemsairbat, which is a possible negative.
runners.comment: Impressed when winning a weak Curragh m'den on debut; in the mix with improvement

runners.name: Subsonic
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m2f Curragh maiden in September (yielding to soft); good third on seasonal return over C&D in a Listed contest in May but soundly beaten in a similar race at Navan next time and a Curragh Group 3 last month (1m2f, good to firm); cheekpieces replace the hood worn the last day; place chance.
runners.comment: Good third over C&D on seasonal return; lesser efforts twice since; place chance back here

runners.name: Hollys Graces
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f AW maiden on debut in September 2024; well-held in four runs last year in good-class company; poor on her return at Dundalk but better in a C&D conditions race last time when chasing home an odds-on favourite; one of the lesser likely candidates all the same.
runners.comment: AW m'den winner was better when second over C&D last time but others more likely

runners.name: Classiest
runners.spotlight: Lived up to her name on debut at Galway last October (1m1f, soft to heavy) when powering 3.75l clear late on to beat a better-fancied stablemate in third; blinkers worn that day are left on but this will be very different to the conditions she excelled in at Galway.
runners.comment: Easily beat better-fancied stablemate on debut last term; better ground to deal with today
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

races.race_name: McEnery Cup Handicap

runners.name: Dallas Star
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner over 1m2f at three; losing sequence stands at 14 since a Dundalk win early last year; flattered by his proximity to star stayer Scandinavia in a 1m6f Listed race at Navan in April; remote seventh behind Illinois in the Queen Alexandra; should not be ruled out on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Has done most of his racing in stakes races, should not be ruled out on handicap debut

runners.name: Obscenity
runners.spotlight: Progressive this season, winning at Navan off 65 and at this venue off 78; failing to maintain his form when well fancied to complete in a premier handicap at the Curragh contested by several of these rivals; that was too bad to be true, unwise to discount.
runners.comment: Progressive before failing to maintain his form in a premier handicap at the Curragh

runners.name: Marazion
runners.spotlight: 1m4f Roscommon maiden winner in May; second of 24 on handicap debut at the Curragh in May (1m6f); ran respectably in 1m4f Cork Group 3; just behind the longer-priced pair Navy Waters and Star Harbour at the Curragh on latest.
runners.comment: Just behind the longer-priced pair Navy Waters and Star Harbour at the Curragh on latest

runners.name: Fixation
runners.spotlight: AW winner got off the mark on turf at the Curragh (1m2f, good-to-firm) in June; took a sharp rise in the ratings for that; well held by Navy Waters on Galway form.
runners.comment: Took a sharp rise in the ratings for Curragh win, well held by Navy Waters on Galway form

runners.name: Daboya
runners.spotlight: Has gone up a total of 13lb for wins at Ballinrobe and Tramore; good 7lb claimer booked here, but not sure to uphold Tramore form with third-placed Sea Coral.
runners.comment: Up 13lb for wins at Ballinrobe and Tramore, not sure to uphold Tramore form with Sea Coral

runners.name: Star Harbour
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run since his last win in September 2024; has had two of his last three starts in Britain; unplaced at Ripon last time, fine effort when second at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) behind subsequent Royal Ascot winner Opportunity; closely matched with Navy Waters on running at the Curragh in June.
runners.comment: On a long losing run, closely matched with Navy Waters on running at the Curragh in June

runners.name: Ephesus
runners.spotlight: Both Flat wins at this trip, a Curragh maiden on good in July 2024 and a Roscommon handicap (soft) last October; back from a spell over jumps to contest two Flat handicaps at Galway; 3lb out of the handicap here, 10lb claimer aboard; others preferred.
runners.comment: Back from a spell over jumps to contest two Flat handicaps at Galway, others preferred

runners.name: Navy Waters
runners.spotlight: 2-13 on the Flat, both wins coming at Down Royal over 10.5f (good) and 1m5f (yielding) last season; consistent this season, never worse than fifth in five outings; looked unlucky in running when fifth of 18 at Galway, capable of getting in the mix.
runners.comment: Looked unlucky in running when fifth of 18 at Galway, capable of getting in the mix

runners.name: Sea Coral
runners.spotlight: Below par first two runs this term; positives can be taken from her last two races; not without a chance of reversing Tramore form with Daboya and Ballinrobe form with War Rooms; worth noting how much market support she attracts relative to stablemate Marazion.
runners.comment: Positives can be taken from her last two races, may reverse Ballinrobe form with War Rooms

runners.name: War Rooms
runners.spotlight: Produced several good displays last season, but his Ballinrobe win last month was his first since 2023; raised 6lb, not guaranteed to back that up; faces a rematch with third-placed Sea Coral.
runners.comment: Ballinrobe win was his first since 2023, raised 6lb, not guaranteed to back that up

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden

runners.name: Karrygrant
runners.spotlight: Placed five times from seven career starts, including when nailed on the line at Bellewstown in April (1m, soft), having tried to make all; runner-up again at Dundalk last time when a neck in front of Rock Of Claremont; his front-running style will suit this track and he's consistent.
runners.comment: Placed in five from seven starts; front-running style will suit here and he's consistent

runners.name: Rock Of Claremont
runners.spotlight: Got tired late on when fifth at the Curragh over 1m on debut (good); improved on the AW last time when taking third (neck behind Karrygrant); cheekpieces are added and he has the form to feature.
runners.comment: Third on AW last time when a neck behind Karrygrant; has the form to feature

runners.name: Gliondar
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; Romanised gelding showed ability in a barrier trial; confirmed promise with an excellent second on debut at the Curragh (1m, good) when a neck second behind the more experienced and now 91-rated Loughrea; gelded since then and should go well.
runners.comment: Excellent second on debut when a neck behind the now 91-rated Loughrea; big chance

runners.name: Jumpingthegun
runners.spotlight: Unfancied in both maidens but didn't run badly over C&D in the second of those when a 4.25l fourth; gelded since running a career best in a Doncaster novice contest last time when a 3l third of five; place chance.
runners.comment: Decent fourth over C&D in June and ran well in novice contest latest; place chance

runners.name: Storm Petrel
runners.spotlight: Has showed improvement in each of her three maiden runs despite huge prices; fourth at Roscommon on return (7.5f, good, 80-1) when green and one place better at the Curragh next time (1m1f, good to firm, 125-1); place chance.
runners.comment: Shown improvement in each of three m'dens at big prices; place chance

runners.name: Yogini
runners.spotlight: Superbly bred (sibling to three Group 1 winners); green when beaten 11l on debut at Dundalk in May; sported this headgear when chasing home an easy winner at Killarney next time (1m4f, good); needs more.
runners.comment: Superbly bred colt chased home an easy winner on second start latest; more needed

runners.name: Xirivella
runners.spotlight: Some promise in her debut and showed good improvement to take third of 17 at Naas next time (1m, good) in a tongue tie (retained); step up in trip could unlock a bit more.
runners.comment: Good improvement when third on her second start; step up in trip may unlock a bit more

runners.name: Salamina
runners.spotlight: Sottsass filly; half-sister to 1m2f winner War Supremo (RPR 81); dam placed 10.6f-2m AW (75), closely related to 7f Group 3 winner Glowing, half-sister to useful 10.6f winner The Anvil, out of half-sister to 1m1f-1m2f Group 1/Grade 1 winner Beat Hollow; Gliondar is stable selected.
runners.comment: Half-sister to 1m2f winner War Supremo (RPR 81); Gliondar is stable selected

runners.name: Socratea
runners.spotlight: Made an eye-catching debut at Naas when a 5.25l seventh of 19 (1m, good), staying on well inside the final furlong; this extra 1.5 furlongs won't go astray.
runners.comment: Eye-catching debut when staying on late; this extra trip won't go astray

runners.name: Lonelyharbourwall
runners.spotlight: Profitable gelding was towards the rear throughout when tailed off in a Roscommon bumper (2m, yielding to soft) eight days ago; a lot of improvement needed but may improve for better ground.
runners.comment: Profitable gelding was tailed off in a bumper eight days ago; big improvement needed

runners.name: Blue Orquidea
runners.spotlight: Fair fifth of 16 at Limerick on debut (7f, soft); didn't step forward for her new yard over 1m here when last of 13 (good); unlikely.
runners.comment: Didn't step forward on stable debut here when last of 13; unlikely

runners.name: Lord Darragh
runners.spotlight: Showed signs of greenness in his Curragh debut (1m, good, 66-1) but it was a creditable staying-on sixth all the same; needs to build on it
runners.comment: Green on debut but was a creditable staying-on sixth; needs to build on it

runners.name: One Cool County
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 66-1 for his debut at Killarney and was tailed off; looks elsewhere.
runners.comment: Sent off at 66-1 for his debut at Killarney and was tailed off; looks elsewhere

runners.name: Highlander Addict
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt in bumpers at Wexford in July (2m1f, good); disappointing Flat debut at Ballinrobe later that month (1m5f, good to yielding); others preferred.
runners.comment: Off the mark at fifth attempt in bumpers; poor Flat debut latest; others preferred

runners.name: Believe Again
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and ran like it in a bumper and two Flat maidens; impossible to fancy.
runners.comment: Huge odds and ran like it in a bumper and two Flat maidens; impossible to fancy

races.race_name: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: She's Ideal
runners.spotlight: Ran respectably in a couple of handicaps earlier this season; several less encouraging displays before winning a claimer at Ballinrobe last month; big weight here on stable debut, Sam Coen's 5lb claim will help.
runners.comment: Won a claimer at Ballinrobe last month, had fair handicap form early in the season

runners.name: Thompson Gunner
runners.spotlight: Has shown all his best form at Dundalk, won there in January, his first success at the 16th attempt; turf credentials are weak.
runners.comment: Has shown all his best form at Dundalk, won there in January, turf credentials are weak

runners.name: La Campanella
runners.spotlight: Mild promise at Dundalk and has run with some credit in two Fairyhouse handicaps; Colin Keane takes the ride for the first time, a tongue-tie is added to the cheekpieces worn last time.
runners.comment: Fair form at Fairyhouse on last two starts, Colin Keane takes the ride for the first time

runners.name: Connova
runners.spotlight: One of the more obvious contenders based on a C&D fourth and two good runs at Ballinrobe; was well supported last time and has a good chance of recovering losses.
runners.comment: One of the more obvious contenders based on a C&D fourth and two good runs at Ballinrobe

runners.name: Georg Zhukov
runners.spotlight: First reserve; Made a breakthrough with AW win in January; followed that with two moderate runs at Dundalk and two poor runs over hurdles; fair fifth over C&D on latest; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, made a breakthrough with AW win in January, fair fifth over C&D on latest

runners.name: Perfect Judgement
runners.spotlight: Four AW wins; 1-21 on turf; fair fifth at Leopardstown in June but down the field at Naas three weeks ago; stable had a Curgah winner last weekend.
runners.comment: Four AW wins, 1-21 on turf, down the field at Naas since an encouraging Leopardstown run

runners.name: William F Browne
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins in 2024; unplaced in three Flat handicaps last month; not disgraced when set a very stiff task in a Galway novice hurdle; soundly beaten in a maiden hurdle at Roscommon last week.
runners.comment: Unplaced in three Flat handicaps last month, two more recent runs have been over hurdles

runners.name: Onyeisi
runners.spotlight: Had fair AW form for Charlie Johnston during the winter, winning over 1m2f and runner-up over 1m4f; no Irish success yet, best effort when fourth at Fairyhouse three starts ago; taken out of an engagement at Ayr on Monday.
runners.comment: AW winner in Britain, no Irish success yet, taken out of an engagement at Ayr on Monday

runners.name: Cameclose
runners.spotlight: Second in a claimer at Ballinrobe in June; this opposition is more taxing, and he needs to step up on previous handicap form.
runners.comment: Second in a claimer at Ballinrobe in June, needs to step up on previous handicap form

runners.name: Gold Dublooms
runners.spotlight: His two best displays (third of 15 and fifth of 15) were achieved at this track last season; recent form raises doubts; hood added now to tongue-tie.
runners.comment: His two best displays were achieved at this track last season, recent form raises doubts

runners.name: No More Hiding
runners.spotlight: Beaten in excess of 10l in three handicap attempts; needs to raise her game; stable had a winner at Galway and another at Leopardstown last week.
runners.comment: Beaten in excess of 10l in three handicap attempts, needs to raise her game

runners.name: Shelbourne Flyer
runners.spotlight: Has attracted good support on all three starts for this stable; kept on well over 7f at Limerick for a never-dangerous sixth; had an excuse (coughing) when soundly beaten at Leopardstown; disappointing in a claimer at Ballinrobe last month.
runners.comment: Has attracted good support on all three starts for this stable, nothing yet to justify it

runners.name: Omissions
runners.spotlight: Showed a little on only start at two; has failed to build on that this season; hood and tongue-tie for the first time; champion jockey booked, so may not be a lost cause.
runners.comment: Showed a little on only start at two, has failed to build on that this season, headgear on

runners.name: Keilah
runners.spotlight: Struck a vein of good form at around this time last season, when placed at Naas and Leopardstown; reverts to the Flat after two runs over hurdles at Sligo; others preferred.
runners.comment: Struck a vein of good form at around this time last season, reverts from hurdling

runners.name: Tullyesker
runners.spotlight: Modest form in maidens last year; down the field on handicap/seasonal debut at Fairyhouse six weeks ago.
runners.comment: Modest form in maidens, down the field on handicap/seasonal debut at Fairyhouse

runners.name: Lohengrin
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Laytown last year; yet to make his presence felt this term; will need to show some sign of revival in advance of a likely return to the beach where he is trained.
runners.comment: Sole win came on the beach at Laytown last year; yet to make his presence felt this term.

runners.name: Pimlico Piranha
runners.spotlight: Unconvincing form in maidens at three different trips; stable's good recent form provides some basis for optimism.
runners.comment: Unconvincing form in maidens, stable's good recent form provides some basis for optimism

runners.name: Bang Po
runners.spotlight: Sole win was on heavy ground in 2023; has struggled in recent seasons; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve; sole win was on heavy ground in 2023, has struggled in recent seasons

runners.name: Pettus Bridge
runners.spotlight: Has shown little in maiden outings at 7f and 1m4f; hard to make a case; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, has shown little in maiden outings at 7f and 1m4f, hard to make a case

runners.name: Giselles Defence
runners.spotlight: Four wins in Britain for Ian Williams at 1m2f, ground-versatile; yet to find form for this stable; hard to fancy despite a much reduced mark, down 19lb since last December.
runners.comment: Four wins in Britain at 1m2f, weak Irish form, hard to fancy despite a much reduced mark

races.race_name: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Miss Crinshawn
runners.spotlight: In the frame in five consecutive outings this year before unplaced at Ballinrobe last time; may struggle to reverse form with the highly consistent Nibras Rainbow.
runners.comment: In the frame in five consecutive outings this year before unplaced at Ballinrobe last time

runners.name: Reponse Finale
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden after 20 starts; solid display when fourth of 17 at Fairyhouse two months ago on her final start for a small County Tipperary yard; has joined a leading stable; possible that the change of scene will bear dividends.
runners.comment: Still a maiden after 20 starts, solid effort on latest, has joined a leading stable

runners.name: Medieval Night
runners.spotlight: Maiden who has run his best races at Leopardstown, placed there last August and in June; also fourth in a 22-race won by Nibras Rainbow; stayed on well from off the pace when sixth of 18 over 1m at Naas three weeks ago.
runners.comment: Maiden who has run his best races at Leopardstown, stayed on well at Naas last time

runners.name: Cleopatra's Needle
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose mare whose last two wins have come over hurdles; ran respectably in that sphere when fourth in a 20-runner handicap at Galway a fortnight ago; second in two of her Flat outings this year but beaten 12l on the second occasion and  appears held by Thegooseiscooked on running at Navan,
runners.comment: Ran well over hurdles at Galway, appears held by Thegooseiscooked on running at Navan

runners.name: Nibras Rainbow
runners.spotlight: Has been highly dependable in recent months, two wins and three places from his last five starts; beat 21 rivals (including Medieval Night) at Leopardstown last month and has a good chance of reaching the money again following a Ballinrobe third that gives him an edge over Miss Crinshawn.
runners.comment: Has been highly dependable in recent months; good chance of reaching the money again

runners.name: Rockbury Lad
runners.spotlight: On a long losing sequence since a 1m Bellewstown success in the early part of last season; unplaced on his last six starts, others seem much more likely.
runners.comment: On a long losing sequence, unplaced on his last six starts, others seem much more likely
runners.owner: P E Ryan & J G Shanahan

runners.name: Thegooseiscooked
runners.spotlight: Won this event last year, following several placed efforts during the summer; should be in peak form for her repeat bid after making a return to form at Navan a month ago, stayed on well after being denied a clear run; tongue-tie fitted for the first time, and Colin Keane aboard for the first time this season, underlining her chance.
runners.comment: Winning favourite in this race last year, back to form at Navan last month, strong chance

runners.name: Shahada Ace
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in eight starts since her sole win, gained over an extended 7f at Tipperary last August; has slumped in the ratings but has a bit to find with Duchess Anne on last month's C&D form; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, unplaced in eight starts since her sole win, has slumped in the ratings

runners.name: Chapel Island
runners.spotlight: Some signs of winning potential; best run when fourth of 16 over 1m3f at Naas on penultimate start; well beaten over 1m5f at Down Royal and dropped in trip now.
runners.comment: Some signs of winning potential, drops in trip now, best run was on his penultimate start

runners.name: Nephin Mountain
runners.spotlight: Was running from 4lb of the handicap at Galway ten days ago and will be more at home in this grade; only 3lb higher than when winning for this rider at Ballinrobe last month.
runners.comment: Unplaced in a stronger race at Galway, only 3lb higher than when winning at Ballinrobe

runners.name: Duchess Anne
runners.spotlight: Unraced at two and three and did not show much last season; bright start to the new campaign when fourth over 1m at Naas; made much of the running when second over C&D last month; holds a definite chance.
runners.comment: Made much of the running when second over C&D last month, holds a definite chance

runners.name: Winston's Promise
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in three maidens over shorter distances; hooded for the first time; hard to fancy; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, soundly beaten in three maidens over shorter distances, hard to fancy

runners.name: Chou Chou
runners.spotlight: Two wins last year, at Tipperary and Clonmel; fifth behind Thegooseiscooked in this race 12 months ago; struggled in a 1m handicap at this venue in June.
runners.comment: Won twice at a modest level last season, struggled in a 1m handicap at this venue in June

runners.name: Urban War
runners.spotlight: Won twice in Britain early in his career; was off for a long time; weak Irish form on the Flat and over hurdles since his return.
runners.comment: Won twice in Britain early in his career, weak Irish form on the Flat and over hurdles

runners.name: Brewel Hill
runners.spotlight: Useful form in 2024, featuring a Ballinrobe win; placed at the same venue during a light 2025 campaign; needs to step up considerably on what he has shown in two 2026 starts.
runners.comment: Useful form in 2024, needs to step up considerably on what he has shown in two 2026 starts

runners.name: Invincible Destiny
runners.spotlight: Frankel filly has shown nothing in maidens over longer distances, finishing in front of only four of her 30 rivals; tongue-tie fitted now for first handicap; that will need to make a radical difference.
runners.comment: Frankel filly has shown nothing in maidens over further, tongue-tie fitted, first handicap

runners.name: Walls Cross
runners.spotlight: Has made little impact in maidens over 1m4f and 1m; has plenty of weight for her handicap debut; up against it.
runners.comment: Has made little impact in maidens over 1m4f and 1m, plenty of weight for handicap debut

runners.name: Money Shuffler
runners.spotlight: Weak form in bumpers and on AW at Dundalk; tailed off in a maiden hurdle at Punchestown in May; first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Weak form on AW, tailed off in a maiden hurdle at Punchestown in May, first-time blinkers

runners.name: Dancing Steve
runners.spotlight: In good form last summer, highlighted by a 1m2f Navan win after two seconds; out of sorts this term, though slightly better when eighth of 22 in a 1m1f handicap at Leopardstown; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, in good form last summer, out of sorts this term, slightly better last time

runners.name: Chavajod
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent on turf last season; out of form at Dundalk last winter; never in contention at Leopardstown in April on his only turf start this year.
runners.comment: Out of form at Dundalk last winter, never in contention on his only turf start this year
runners.owner: D P Coakley & J F Costello & A Connick & P Coakley

races.race_name: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Forbidden Fire
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to six winners including See The Fire (7f-1m2f including 2yo/Group 2; RPR 121), Venetian Prince (7f 2yo/1m3f Group 2 Italian Derby; 105) and Spirit Mixer (1m4f-2m including AW; 104); dam 5f-1m2f winner (including 2yo/Group 1; 116); striking pedigree, although likely for further, and stable have won this race in two of the last four seasons (both winners had previous experience).
runners.comment: Group 1-winning dam's first six progeny have all won (including Group 1); newcomer of note

runners.name: Easy Answer
runners.spotlight: Promise amidst inexperience on his debut at Yarmouth (6f, good) in May; thrown in the deep end in the Group 2 Coventry Stakes eight weeks ago and finished well beaten, albeit his track position wasn't ideal; capable of further progress.
runners.comment: Promise on debut before a stiff task at Royal Ascot; still capable of better

runners.name: First Mate
runners.spotlight: Yet to land a blow in two novice runs this summer, the latest at Ffos Las (7.4f, good) last week; others bring more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Not landed a blow in two novice runs (6f/7.4f) this summer; nurseries beckon

runners.name: Saturn Star
runners.spotlight: 70,000euros yearling, 125,000gns breeze-up 2yo; second foal; half-brother to 7f/1m winner Sea Suite (including 2yo; RPR 88); dam 1m5f winner (64), half-sister to Listed winners Ayrad (1m2f/1m4f) and Dawn Of Hope (9.5f); bred for 7f+ but he starts out at a realistic level so needs a market check.
runners.comment: 125,000gns breeze-up 2yo; bred for a bit further but he is starting out in a winnable race

runners.name: Gold Reef City
runners.spotlight: Modest RPRs in two starts this summer (6f, good and good to firm), in need of the experience on each occasion; may need more time.
runners.comment: Modest RPRs in two 6f runs this summer; may need more time

runners.name: Hackpen Hill
runners.spotlight: Recorded RPRs in the low 40s in his two runs last month (both 6f on good to firm); the addition of a hood isn't enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Modest RPRs in two 6f novice runs last month; the new hood is not enough to tempt

runners.name: Arctic Tsar
runners.spotlight: He has run to a modest level in two novice runs this summer, both over 6f (good/good to firm); bred to stay further and nurseries over 7f+ may see him in a better light.
runners.comment: Modest form in two 6f novices this summer; may do better in nurseries over further

runners.name: Ongombo
runners.spotlight: Comfortably held in two starts at Kempton (6f, Polytrack); pedigree suggests handicaps over much further may suit in due course.
runners.comment: Down the field in two AW runs; progress may coincide with a step up in trip

runners.name: Goodwood Meteor
runners.spotlight: No better than midfield in two 6f novices (soft and good to firm) this summer; latest effort was better but another good step forward will be required to win.
runners.comment: No better than midfield in two 6f novices this summer; needs a good surge of improvement

races.race_name: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap

runners.name: Supreme King
runners.spotlight: Won a Class 5 over C&D (soft) in June and followed that with three runner-up finishes; beaten favourite at Goodwood a fortnight ago but he was racing away from the main action and shaped as though still in top form; Oisin Murphy retains the ride; solid claims.
runners.comment: Held his form well since a C&D win in June; poor track position latest; should go well

runners.name: Dr Strangelove
runners.spotlight: Two wins as a 3yo, the latter a C&D handicap off 1lb lower last October; good runs in defeat on his last two starts (7f, soft and good to firm); should make another bold bid.
runners.comment: C&D winner last October off 1lb lower; runner-up over 7f on last two starts;  contender

runners.name: Regional Rock
runners.spotlight: Turned over at long odds-on at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) on his return from a year on the sidelines; finished just in front of Dandana when third at Windsor on last month's handicap debut; still has time to deliver a bigger performance.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 3yo; good third (neck in front of Dandana) on handicap debut; more to come

runners.name: An Outlaw's Grace
runners.spotlight: More exposed than most but he is down in the weights and his latest Windsor fourth can be upgraded as he had to wait for a gap to appear; this is a higher grade though.
runners.comment: On a reduced mark and latest Windsor fourth can be upgraded; this is a higher grade though

runners.name: Dandana
runners.spotlight: Landed 6f novices at Kempton and Ripon before posting an excellent fourth in York's Lowther Stakes last August; down the field on her return but fared much better when fourth at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 16 days ago; yard going well and the fitting of a tongue-tie may help; key player.
runners.comment: Useful 2yo; latest Windsor 4th was promising; now tongue tied; key player

runners.name: Golden Brown
runners.spotlight: Had some solid form as a 2yo and he belatedly shed his maiden tag with a C&D (good ground) win in May; only eighth in a big-field handicap at York 60 days ago; eased in grade but needs to raise his game to win.
runners.comment: C&D win in May was followed by a fair run in a hot York handicap; needs more here though

runners.name: So Darn Hot
runners.spotlight: Progressive 2yo/3yo; he has faced some stiff tasks for his new yard this year and has come up short; his sights are lowered here, however, and 6f on fast ground won't faze him; respected now down into a 0-90 with headgear dispensed with.
runners.comment: Some stiff tasks for Ed Walker this year & he's come up short; down in class; no headgear

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Scommessa Sicura
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on first three starts before winning a fillies' maiden at 2-1 at Newmarket's July meeting (7f, good to firm); the Newmarket runner-up has since finished third in a Listed race and she's in good hands to continue to progress; not discounted.
runners.comment: Won Newmarket maiden last month on fourth start and that form has been franked by the 2nd

runners.name: Firehorse
runners.spotlight: 11-1 winner on debut at Kempton (6f, AW) in June and beaten just over 3l when fifth of ten at 40-1 in Listed race at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last month; he's closely matched with the Ascot third Dandyman Dan and there's stamina in his pedigree; not ruled out now tackling 1m.
runners.comment: Kempton debut winner who was creditable Listed 5th at Ascot last month; he's not ruled out

runners.name: Quest For Stars
runners.spotlight: Rallied to win on debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month and followed up in Sandown novice (7f, good to firm); both wins have been pretty tight but he has a good attitude and this Sea The Stars colt could relish today's extra furlong, with his dam a 1m 2yo Listed winner.
runners.comment: 2-2; both wins have been pretty tight but he could relish today's extra furlong

runners.name: Velociraptor
runners.spotlight: Third on debut at Newmarket's July meeting (7f, good to firm) and won at Chester (7f, good) subsequently; this is a tougher test of his credentials but his trainer has a useful 2yo team and he may be suited by 1m; chance.
runners.comment: Won at Chester on second start; this is tougher but trainer has a useful 2yo team; chance

runners.name: Rocket Boy
runners.spotlight: Belied his 22-1 odds and a slow start to win a six-runner novice on his debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; it was a performance in keeping with his useful pedigree and he could have plenty more to offer, especially now up to 1m; possible contender.
runners.comment: Belied 22-1 odds & slow start to win on debut at Yarmouth; could have plenty more to offer

runners.name: My A'Ali Baba
runners.spotlight: Chepstow debut winner (6f, good to soft) who rallied for a good third in Sandown novice (7f, good) last month; suffered interference when mid-division on recent nursery debut at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm) but nevertheless looks up against it in today's company.
runners.comment: Suffered interference when midfield in Glorious Goodwood nursery but looks up against it

races.race_name: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Remi Mae
runners.spotlight: Finished first past the post in a maiden at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago but was demoted due to interference; she has her limitations but nevertheless holds leading claims in this field.
runners.comment: First past post at Nottingham last time (demoted due to interference); leading claims

runners.name: Bold Shout
runners.spotlight: Made debut in June and he showed ability when fourth on his first two starts (6f/7f, good to firm/soft), the latest here; gelded since and this half-brother to Italian Group 3 winner Rainbow Royal is open to improvement.
runners.comment: Showed ability on first two starts; gelded since; open to improvement; one to consider

runners.name: Annie Sioux
runners.spotlight: 15,000euros foal, 40,000gns yearling; third foal; Sioux Nation sister to 5f/6f winner Shagraan (including Listed); dam 7f/1m winner (RPR 97); trainer also saddles Bold Shout, who has shown promise previously, and the betting could be informative on debut.
runners.comment: Sister to talented sprinter Shagraan; one of two for the yard; market could be informative

runners.name: Gris De Chine
runners.spotlight: She's shown some ability across her four starts and could be suited by this step back up to 6f; however, low-grade handicaps are likely to be a better pathway to success.
runners.comment: She's shown some ability but low-grade handicaps are likely to be a better option

runners.name: Kodicall
runners.spotlight: Fifth of seven on last month's debut at Ffos Las (5f, good) and second of six at Bath (5.7f, firm) subsequently; however, this looks a better race than last time and he needs another step forward.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Bath on second start but this looks a better race; needs another step forward
runners.owner: Mrs Wendy Jarrett & J S Moore

runners.name: Just Dreaming
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on all three starts and improvement is necessary if she's to be a force this afternoon.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on all three starts and improvement is necessary this afternoon

runners.name: It's A Mugs Game
runners.spotlight: Well beaten for James Tate on sole 2yo start and not disgraced when fourth of six on recent stable and seasonal debut at Bath (5.7f, firm); however, others have much stronger form.
runners.comment: Not disgraced on stable/seasonal debut at Bath but others have much stronger form

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Felicitas
runners.spotlight: Won her first two starts (1m/1m2f, AW/good) then finished second to subsequent Oaks runner-up Legacy Link in the Group 3 Musidora at York (1m2f, good); soundly beaten in the Group 1 Prix de Diane at Chantilly (1m2f, good to firm) last time but is in with a big shout now back down in grade.
runners.comment: Runner-up in Musidora then soundly beaten in Prix de Diane; big shout back down in grade

runners.name: Miss Scott
runners.spotlight: Won at Leicester (7f, good to soft) last September on sole 2yo start; both runs this season have been in novice races at Newbury, reappearing with a close second (1m1f, good to soft) and winning last time (1m2f, good to firm); this unexposed 3yo goes up in grade today but is a half-sister to two Listed winners and is in top hands, and could play a leading role.
runners.comment: Two wins from her three starts; up in grade but she's a half-sister to two Listed winners

runners.name: On Message
runners.spotlight: Close Listed third at Goodwood (1m2f, good) in May and that form has worked out extremely well; tailed off in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft) next time and behind Regal Charm when fourth of five in Listed race at York (1m2f, good to firm) last time; not written off but has to raise her game.
runners.comment: Of interest on her Listed third at Goodwood in May but two lesser performances since

runners.name: Annastarzy
runners.spotlight: Won three handicaps in a row (1m/7f, good/good to firm) prior to respectable sixth of 14 in handicap at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good) a fortnight ago; further improvement is necessary up in grade but this 3yo's pedigree suggests the step up in trip could be a plus and she's not discounted.
runners.comment: Handicap winning spree came to an end last time but the step up in trip could be a plus

runners.name: Regal Charm
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who reappeared with easy win in C&D handicap (soft) last month; no match for the 1-2 winner when Listed second of five at York recently (1m2f, good to firm) but that performance entitles her to respect.
runners.comment: No match for winner when Listed second at York but that effort entitles her to respect

runners.name: Goldilocks Cen
runners.spotlight: Won 1m3f maiden at Dieppe last July; respectable fifth in Listed race at Pontefract (1m, good) last month; well beaten either side of that (1m/7f); goes back up in trip today but looks opposable.
runners.comment: Respectable Listed fifth at Pontefract last month but looks opposable today

runners.name: Alla Stella
runners.spotlight: She's 0-8 in Group 3 and Listed races but has finished runner-up in Listed contests in France on her last two starts (10.5f/1m4f, good/soft); there is every chance that she will be in the mix.
runners.comment: Runner-up in French Listed races on last two starts and every chance she'll be in the mix

races.race_name: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap

runners.name: Fox Avatar
runners.spotlight: Dual Polytrack winner last summer; returned after 279 days off with a fair effort at Kempton (1m4f) in May but he was disappointing on his return visit the following month; has bit to prove after that but he still has low mileage and his first win was on turf (1m2f, good).
runners.comment: Disappointing at Kempton latest but he still has low mileage and his first win was on turf

runners.name: Carnival Day
runners.spotlight: Two creditable efforts at Epsom (8.5f/1m4f) from his three runs this season; could go well again back at his optimum trip but his last win was 13 months ago and he's ideally suited by good or slower ground.
runners.comment: Hard to rule out back at his optimum trip but he's ideally suited by good or slower ground

runners.name: Eupator
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been on AW but he's run well on turf this season including when runner-up at Carlisle (1m) in May and when third over this trip at Windsor (good to firm) last time; continues to edge down the weights and he's in the mix with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Fair third at Windsor (1m2f) last time and he's in the mix with cheekpieces added
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing I and Partner

runners.name: Mythical Bird
runners.spotlight: Hard to predict and has record of 1-15 but she bounced back with a good third in a Class 4 at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last month; has possibilities if she can back that up and she's still lightly raced on turf.
runners.comment: Hard to predict but was third at Windsor last time and has claims if he can back that up

runners.name: Miss Tonnerre
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Newmarket (7f, good) in July 2024 but she's 0-8 since and was tailed off on her reappearance at Kempton (1m4f, AW) in May; continues to drop down the weights but has plenty to prove after another break.
runners.comment: 0-8 since debut win and was tailed off on AW in May; lots to prove after another break

runners.name: Almekarem
runners.spotlight: Returned after a gelding operation with a win at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) last month and he had an excuse when upped to 1m4f at Newmarket (took strong hold) next time; still looks feasibly treated on his penultimate form and he's an interesting contender back in trip.
runners.comment: Reappeared with a Lingfield win and he had an excuse over 1m4f latest; interesting

runners.name: Londoner
runners.spotlight: Triple AW winner who is 0-24 on turf but he ran well to finish second behind an unexposed improver at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) 11 days ago; on same mark here and he's a big player if he can repeat that form.
runners.comment: 0-24 on turf but was runner-up behind an unexposed improver at Lingfield latest; respected

races.race_name: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)

runners.name: Lexington Boom
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in 5f maidens at Musselburgh and here, last time finishing clear of the third despite a troubled passage; not ideally drawn in 12 but has good form claims.
runners.comment: Not ideally drawn in 12 but has good form claims

runners.name: True Charm
runners.spotlight: Clear promise on debut and latest run at Chester was better than it looks having raced up with the pace before fading; now gelded and wears a tongue-tie; possibilities.
runners.comment: Two of his three runs respectable; now gelded and wears a tongue-tie; possibilities

runners.name: Spectacular Diver
runners.spotlight: Hasn't progressed from finishing second of four behind a useful horse on debut; he could turn a corner now gelded; market may be informative.
runners.comment: Not progressed from a promising debut but he has been gelded since his last run

runners.name: Needin' U
runners.spotlight: Beaten 2l in a seller last time but that form still reads okay in this company; wears a first-time hood.
runners.comment: Beaten 2l in a seller last time but that form still reads okay in this company; now hooded

runners.name: Ard As A Rock
runners.spotlight: Only fifth and ninth but in stronger races than this at Newbury and Goodwood (both over 6f); showed pace in both.
runners.comment: Only fifth and ninth but in stronger races than this at Newbury and Goodwood

runners.name: Ubettabequeen
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Canaria Queen (5f/5.5f; RPR 74) and Canaria Prince (5f; 64); dam tough 5f/6f winner (98), out of 5f winning half-sister to 5f/6f Listed winner Angus Newz; yard's newcomers usually best watched but speedy pedigree and well drawn in one.
runners.comment: Yard's newcomers usually best watched but speedy pedigree and well drawn in one

runners.name: One More Tilda
runners.spotlight: First foal out of a 5f 2yo winner (RPR 79) and half-sister to 6f-7.3f winner Burdett; would need to see some confidence behind her.
runners.comment: First foal out of a 5f 2yo winner (RPR 79) and half-sister to 6f-7.3f winner Burdett

runners.name: Taj Mahal Palace
runners.spotlight: £30,000 breeze-up 2yo (private sale); 20-1 when withdrawn on intended debut after getting upset in the stalls; drawn widest.
runners.comment: 20-1 when withdrawn on intended debut after getting upset in the stalls

runners.name: Scottys Rocket
runners.spotlight: Couldn't recommend after her heavy defeat here 23 days ago when 28-1.
runners.comment: Couldn't recommend after her heavy defeat here 23 days ago when 28-1

runners.name: Tiggywinkle
runners.spotlight: Performed to a modest level when well down the field over an extended 6f at Doncaster (12-1).
runners.comment: Performed to a modest level when well down the field over an extended 6f at Doncaster

runners.name: Classy Jaguar
runners.spotlight: 125-1 for his C&D debut and managed only seventh, finishing behind Lexington Boom.
runners.comment: 125-1 for his C&D debut and managed only seventh, finishing behind Lexington Boom

runners.name: Desert Outlaw
runners.spotlight: Modest so far and comfortably held by Lexington Boom on their recent course clash.
runners.comment: Modest so far and comfortably held by Lexington Boom on their recent course clash

runners.name: Mubehir
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in his two races at odds of 33-1 and 150-1 respectively.
runners.comment: Tailed off in his two races at odds of 33-1 and 150-1 respectively

races.race_name: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)

runners.name: Empire Rising
runners.spotlight: Competitive in his last three races, the latest a 6f nursery at Ripon on first run after being gelded; looks ready for 7f.
runners.comment: Competitive in his last three races, the latest a nursery; looks ready for 7f

runners.name: Coco Nova
runners.spotlight: 65,000euros yearling; caught the eye in the paddock and in the race when fourth at Doncaster (7f) and that form has worked out well; ran green so improvement looks on the cards.
runners.comment: Ran green when fourth at Doncaster (7f) and that form has worked out well

runners.name: Real Edition
runners.spotlight: In rear throughout on 6f debut but raced prominently when fourth of ten at Southwell (7f); shouldn't be too far away if repeating that effort.
runners.comment: In rear throughout on 6f debut but raced prominently when fourth of ten at Southwell (7f)

runners.name: Black Fury
runners.spotlight: Both runs over this far, the best on debut when fourth of nine on the AW; has to improve.
runners.comment: Both runs over this far, the best on debut when fourth of nine on the AW; has to improve

runners.name: High On Honey
runners.spotlight: 16,000gns yearling; second foal out of a French 1m4f winner; yard's newcomers usually best monitored.
runners.comment: 16,000gns yearling; second foal out of a French 1m4f winner

runners.name: You Got Know How
runners.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-brother to French 1m1f winner Starzo Fal; dam French 1m2f 2yo winner, half-sister to 1m4f Listed winner Merveillo; he's not kicking off in a strong race so hard to dismiss.
runners.comment: 40,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-brother to French 1m1f winner Starzo Fal

runners.name: Hair Raising
runners.spotlight: Beaten about 12l in a small field over 5f here a month ago when 22-1; soon up in trip.
runners.comment: Beaten about 12l in a small field over 5f here a month ago when 22-1; soon up in trip

runners.name: Quintillion
runners.spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; fourth foal; brother to winners Quebella (8.6f; RPR 91) and Star Studied (1m; 89), half-brother to 6f AW winner Henriette Ronner (66); dam 1m-1m4f winner, out of Italian 1m2f Group 1 winner; nice pedigree and needs checking in the betting.
runners.comment: 55,000gns yearling; nice pedigree and needs checking in the betting

runners.name: Astral Calling
runners.spotlight: Weak in the betting for her runs here and at Southwell (at about 7f) and likely that a nursery will be next.
runners.comment: Weak in the betting for her runs here and at Southwell (at about 7f)

runners.name: Loveulongtime
runners.spotlight: Already looks limited, last time finishing well behind in a field of four; has raced over 7f, 6f and latterly 5f.
runners.comment: Already looks limited, last time finishing well behind in a field of four

runners.name: Diplomacy
runners.spotlight: Beaten 11l when sixth of eight on debut but that was at York (7f) and this should be easier.
runners.comment: Beaten 11l when sixth of eight on debut but that was at York (7f)

runners.name: Be More Ruthless
runners.spotlight: Beaten about 29l and 18l in two maidens over 7f; no appeal for now.
runners.comment: Beaten about 29l and 18l in two maidens over 7f; no appeal for now

races.race_name: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap

runners.name: Alice's Influence
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form when a visor was first fitted; no further progress kept to turf since but today's change of headgear may have positive effect.
runners.comment: 1-10; a visor worked well initially so could be interesting in the new blinkers

runners.name: King Sharja
runners.spotlight: His three turf wins have come around here so that's a positive and twice finished second this year; possibilities back here from a handy draw.
runners.comment: Twice second this year and his three turf wins have come around here

runners.name: Willowinghurn
runners.spotlight: Won twice last season (6f, good to firm; 7f, soft) but she's not been shaping as though about to win again; perhaps the new visor will assist.
runners.comment: Modest of late but won twice last season and now goes in a first-time visor

runners.name: Ganthorpe
runners.spotlight: Has slipped back into modest mode since winning over 6f at Carlisle in May and has stamina to prove over this far.
runners.comment: Has slipped back into modest mode since winning over 6f at Carlisle in May

runners.name: Elettaria
runners.spotlight: Has done most of her winning on the AW and recent turf form is uninspiring; others preferred.
runners.comment: Has done most of her winning on the AW and recent turf form is uninspiring

runners.name: Mister Sky Blue
runners.spotlight: Only 1-25; the blinkers were left off when going close over 6f at Thirsk last week; that was a classified race and he's probably better at 6f than 7f.
runners.comment: Third last week but in a classified race and he's probably better at 6f than 7f

runners.name: The New Bay Pearl
runners.spotlight: Formerly with Roger Varian; now 0-13 but ran well for a long way over 1m at Pontefract last time; probably has a race in her off this mark.
runners.comment: Now 0-13 but ran well for a long way over 1m at Pontefract last time

runners.name: Dabbling
runners.spotlight: Hasn't been running too badly over 5f, beaten under 3l in her last three races; whether she'll get this far remains to be seen.
runners.comment: Hasn't been running too badly over 5f, beaten under 3l in her last three races; new trip

runners.name: Power Of Chora
runners.spotlight: Close up over 5f here three runs back but signed off for Joey Ramsden with two quiet runs; no headgear this time and there are stamina queries.
runners.comment: Close up over 5f here three runs back but signed off for Joey Ramsden with two quiet runs

runners.name: Bantz
runners.spotlight: Well treated on last year's form but hasn't got anything going since moving yards; now goes in cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Well treated on last year's form but hasn't got anything going since moving yards

runners.name: Ryefield
runners.spotlight: No wins in nine and well behind in six races since finishing second in a maiden last September; has tried cheekpieces and a visor in last two races.
runners.comment: No wins in nine and well behind in six races since finishing second in a maiden last Sept

runners.name: Sir David
runners.spotlight: On another career-low mark after a 4l third at Doncaster (7f) where he travelled well but didn't finish with any great purpose; 1-19 and has a wide draw.
runners.comment: Fair run last time out but 1-19 and has a wide draw

runners.name: Mickey Mongoose
runners.spotlight: Four of his five wins have been on the AW, the latest at Southwell in May (7f; 2lb lower); can be inconsistent and doesn't have the best of draws.
runners.comment: Better on the AW; can be inconsistent and doesn't have the best of draws

runners.name: Furrst Lady
runners.spotlight: Modest form so far, including in two handicaps; tried cheekpieces last time and they're left off; new trainer but same owners.
runners.comment: Modest form so far, including in two handicaps; tried cheekpieces last time

races.race_name: Jill Willows Handicap

runners.name: Alpha Capture
runners.spotlight: Has done well for this yard, in handicaps from 6f to 1m; he wasn't beaten far in a big field at York two runs ago after hitting some traffic and the winner (favourite) got first run on him when closing fast in a recent claimer at Chester (front two dominated); good chance off this mark back in a handicap, especially with Conor Whiteley taking off 5lb.
runners.comment: Good chance off this mark back in a handicap, with Conor Whiteley taking off 5lb

runners.name: Homestrait
runners.spotlight: Arrives here in a consistent run of form and was bang there when fourth at Redcar latest (1m); probably better over a stiff 7f so firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: Arrives here in consistent run of form and bang there when fourth at Redcar latest (1m)

runners.name: Obelix
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner who is usually held up (can start slowly) and he needs everything to drop right; capable off this mark but if missing the kick from stall 1 he could be behind the black ball.
runners.comment: Needs all to drop right; if missing the kick from stall 1 he may be behind the black ball
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd & Julie Camacho

runners.name: Highland Olly
runners.spotlight: A third win this year when scoring by a length here last month and reportedly never travelled next time at Chester; could be given another chance, though the draw is not ideal.
runners.comment: Won here before failing to give his running at Chester; the draw is not ideal

runners.name: Tattie Bogle
runners.spotlight: Versatile tactically and his last win was here in June; 6lb higher now but was runner-up off this mark at Lingfield four days ago (7f AW) when in first-time cheekpieces; each-way claims.
runners.comment: Course winner; runner-up off this mark four days ago when in first-time cheekpieces

runners.name: Style Of Life
runners.spotlight: Three wins from an extended 7f to 1m for current yard; seemed to need the run at York on seasonal debut, though that was three months ago.
runners.comment: Three wins from an extended 7f to 1m for current yard; off for three months
runners.owner: Rise One Racing - Style Of Life

runners.name: Flying Fletcher
runners.spotlight: 3-21 on the AW but 0-16 on the grass, never in the first two; beaten about 10l in last two races; not hard to turn elsewhere.
runners.comment: 3-21 on the AW but 0-16 on the grass, never in the first two

runners.name: Beyond The Bar
runners.spotlight: Made all at Catterick (7f; 3lb lower) but couldn't repeat the trick over Ripon's 1m and he stays that far; however, not all horses take to Ripon and no surprise should he run well.
runners.comment: Below par latest but not all horses take to Ripon and this front-runner could bounce back

runners.name: Bell Shot
runners.spotlight: Races prominently; easy winner of this 12 months ago when only 2lb lower and he returns on the back of some solid efforts, the latest over 6f which has to bode well; good chance.
runners.comment: Easy winner of this last year off 2lb lower; excellent latest run over 6f
runners.owner: SBK Racing & B & J Parr Racing Ltd

runners.name: Glenfinnan
runners.spotlight: Course winner in May and only a length away at Carlisle three starts later; not sure what happened at Thirsk 11 days ago but has a big run in him.
runners.comment: Not sure what happened at Thirsk 11 days ago but has a big run in him

runners.name: Intervention
runners.spotlight: Hurtling down the weights but for good reason as this multiple winner is looking very regressive.
runners.comment: Hurtling down the weights but for good reason as this multiple winner is regressing

races.race_name: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap

runners.name: Princess Niyla
runners.spotlight: 3-40 so not easy to win with, but last two victories have come over C&D and she was close up over 1m at Doncaster last time.
runners.comment: Last two victories have come over C&D and she was close up over 1m at Doncaster last time

runners.name: Kitsune Power
runners.spotlight: Snapped a losing run when over C&D last month and the race didn't go smoothly for him when third at Redcar; considered.
runners.comment: Recent C&D winner and the race didn't go smoothly for him when third at Redcar

runners.name: Ciao Capo
runners.spotlight: Won a pair of 1m2f fast-ground Class 6s before found wanting in a Class 4 at York; might still be on a realistic mark and this is easier than last time.
runners.comment: Might still be on a realistic mark and this is easier than last time

runners.name: Sunny Orange
runners.spotlight: Four wins here and nearly made that five last month on two occasions, since when he's again gone close at Pontefract; likely contender off the same mark as for last two runs.
runners.comment: Bang there in his last three races and he's a four-time winner around here

runners.name: Dr Rio
runners.spotlight: Six-time course winner and a regular here; beaten just over 2l over C&D last month when he was on the back foot after starting slowly; hard to rule out.
runners.comment: Six-time course winner and a regular here; beaten just over 2l over C&D last month

runners.name: No Knee Never
runners.spotlight: All four wins on the AW and 0-15 on turf, though has been running well at 1m-1m2f on grass this year without getting the job done; does have to bounce back from a poor one, however.
runners.comment: 0-15 on turf, though has been running well at 1m-1m2f on grass this year

runners.name: Langton Wold
runners.spotlight: Flat/hurdle winner; hasn't threatened in two runs since returning from a long absence and he's 3lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Not threatened since returning from a long absence and he's 3lb out of the weights
runners.owner: Brian Ellison Racing Club & M Dale

runners.name: Bearwith
runners.spotlight: Ten career wins divided between turf and the AW; well on top last time at Newcastle under Tom Kiely-Marshall but back up 5lb and it's been over two years since he defied a mark in the 70s.
runners.comment: A winner last time but up 5lb and over two years since he defied a mark in the 70s

races.race_name: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap

runners.name: Simba's Pride
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 6f on good ground in May; beaten favourite in his last four starts while leaving the impression this mark was still in range if things panned out better for him; shortlist material.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite last four starts but leaves impression this mark is in range; shortlisted

runners.name: Qila
runners.spotlight: Unexposed maiden; underwent wind surgery prior to last week's good third at Thirsk (5f, good; tongue tied first time); today's stiffer test will suit and he should have a bigger run in him soon.
runners.comment: Good third at Thirsk last week on his first run after a wind op; open to further progress

runners.name: Straight Ahead
runners.spotlight: Just a neck behind Angel Numbers when second at Thirsk (5f, good to firm) last month and he is 7lb better off today; should remain competitive with conditions unlikely to bother him.
runners.comment: 7lb better off with Angel Numbers for a neck defeat last month; should remain competitive

runners.name: Kilfrush Desert
runners.spotlight: Placed in her three runs in maiden/novice company, recording her best RPR on AW (6f) in April; makes her handicap debut at a realistic level and the betting should be revealing.
runners.comment: Placed in three novice/maiden runs; goes handicapping at a realistic level; check market

runners.name: Dragon Spin
runners.spotlight: Good series of efforts ground to a halt at York (5.4f, good to firm) 19 days ago; needs a full revival and she has copped the outside stall.
runners.comment: Form dipped at York last month and she has the widest stall to contend with this time

runners.name: Lamlash Bay
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a 6f handicap at Ripon last month; creditable fifth at Doncaster 17 days later; well drawn to attack and should be quick enough for 5f; respected.
runners.comment: Made all over 6f last month before a creditable fifth at Doncaster; well drawn down to 5f

runners.name: Rumble Ruby
runners.spotlight: Good step forward when turning over the red-hot favourite in a 6f novice at Lingfield (good ground) in June; similar form when fourth in a handicap back at that track 18 days ago; more will be needed to come out on top here and she wouldn't want to be blowing the start from stall 2.
runners.comment: 6f turf win in June; fair fourth on handicap debut but this looks a stronger race

runners.name: Black Missile
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; no improvement for wind surgery when third of seven at Nottingham last month; drops back to 5f with a point to prove.
runners.comment: 0-6 & no improvement for wind op when 3rd at Nottingham last month; needs more back at 5f

runners.name: Angel Numbers
runners.spotlight: 2-2 since joining Ruth Carr, winning 5f handicaps at Thirsk last month and at Ripon last week; penalty for the latest small-field success demands more and a double-figure stall isn't ideal either.
runners.comment: 2-2 for new yard but penalty and a wide stall could leave her vulnerable in hat-trick bid
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing Xviii And Ruth Carr

runners.name: Under The Radar
runners.spotlight: Third in 5f handicaps on his last two starts, finishing behind Angel Numbers and Straight Ahead on the former occasion; dropped another 1lb but his stable may have stronger claims with Hanney Girl.
runners.comment: Placed on last two starts but behind two of today's rivals on former occasion; yard run 2

runners.name: Hanney Girl
runners.spotlight: Two wins last summer, including C&D (good to firm); this season has been tough going but she has been contesting stronger races than this one; not discounted.
runners.comment: C&D win as a 2yo; struggling this year but in much deeper races; not ruled out

races.race_name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Marsala
runners.spotlight: Out of a dual 7f Listed winner and made promising debut when fourth of 13 in Newbury novice (6f, good to firm) won by a smart filly six weeks ago; moves up in trip here; ought to play a major role.
runners.comment: Fourth of 13 in 6f Newbury novice won by a smart filly six weeks ago; likely contender

runners.name: Sweltering
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Holloway Boy (7f/1m including 2yo/AW/Group 3; RPR 118) and Humidity (6f/7f 2yo including Listed; 108); dam unraced sister to useful 6f-8.6f winner Supersta; one of two well-bred newcomers for her owners in this race.
runners.comment: One of two well-bred newcomers for her owners in this race

runners.name: Miss Miniver
runners.spotlight: 800,000gns yearling; sixth foal; closely related to 1m/1m1f winner Facteur Cheval (including UAE Group 1; RPR 122), half-sister to a US stakes winner; dam unraced half-sister to French 5f/6f Group 3 winner Tantheem; with that price tag she's an intriguing debutante.
runners.comment: 800,000gns yearling; closely related to UAE Group 1 winner Facteur Cheval; shortlisted

runners.name: Thuritha
runners.spotlight: Out of a fairly useful 6f/7f AW winner; 50-1, showed only minor promise when fifth of seven in slowly run Newmarket novice (7f, goo to firm) last month; probably one for a bit further down the line.
runners.comment: 50-1, showed only minor promise when fifth of seven on last month's Newmarket debut
