runners.name: Coaxed
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-sister to winners Cajole (7f/1m including AW/Listed; RPR 104), Theoryofeverything (Group-placed 7f-1m1f; 102) and Persist (1m/1m2f; 100); dam 1m winner (including 2yo/AW/Group 1; 121), half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Creative Force; with a top stable and makes strong appeal on paper.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly from a top stable; makes strong appeal on paper

runners.name: Cullenagh Rainbow
runners.spotlight: 80,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; first foal; dam Listed-placed 6f winner (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Mammas Girl (7f Group 3), Master Of War (6f 2yo Listed) and Arabie (6f 2yo Group 2); has nice pedigree but stable is not prolific with first-time-out 2yos.
runners.comment: Has nice pedigree but stable is not prolific with first-time-out 2yos

runners.name: Friendly Force
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to winners Persian Force (5f/6f 2yo including Group 2; RPR 108) and Gubbass (Group-placed 5f-1m including 2yo/Qatar; 107); dam unraced half-sister to useful 7f winner Queen Of Power (dam of 6f Group 3 winner Garrus); no surprise if she features on debut.
runners.comment: Sister to a 6f 2yo Group 2 winner; no surprise if she features on debut

runners.name: Sweet Katarina
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to a Hungarian 7f/1m3f winner; dam German 1m3f winner, half-sister to two US Grade 2 winners; less interesting than some of the other newcomers in this field.
runners.comment: Out of a German 1m3f winner; less interesting than some of the other newcomers

runners.name: South China Sea
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; sister to Group-placed 1m2f AW 2yo winner Empress Wu (RPR 100), half-sister to winners Fleur De Chine (7f-1m4f including Listed; 106) and Song Brocade (1m2f; 78); dam 1m 2yo winner (89), sister to 1m4f Group 1 winner Madame Chiang; drawn wide on debut and may find 7f a bit sharp.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly but has wide draw on debut and may find 7f a bit sharp

runners.name: Speed Nation
runners.spotlight: Out of a useful miler; towards rear throughout on her debut here (6f) five weeks ago but was only 3-1 for that and represents stable with excellent 2yo strike-rate; might get closer to the target today.
runners.comment: Made low-key debut here last month but stable has excellent 2yo strike-rate
runners.owner: Duaij Al Khalifa & Ahmad Al Qassimi

runners.name: Spirit Of Progress
runners.spotlight: Out of a Listed AW winner but was behind Marsala when a well-beaten 200-1 shot on debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) six weeks ago.
runners.comment: Well-beaten 200-1 shot on debut at Newbury (6f) six weeks ago

runners.name: Please Don't Go
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to an Italian Listed winner but was unable to justify her prominence in the betting when down the field on debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) ten weeks ago.
runners.comment: Unable to justify prominence in betting when down the field on debut at Newbury (6.5f)

races.race_name: Unibet/Breeders Backing Racing EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Manaar
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut at Newbury (1m1f, good to soft; 8-1) in June but the runner-up reversed those placings back there over 1m2f last month (good to firm); this half-sister to the yard's 1m4f Group 1 winner Dubai Honour now steps up in trip for her AW debut and there should be more to come; stable has won this for the last two years.
runners.comment: Made a winning debut at Newbury and second there last time; steps up to 1m4f for AW debut

runners.name: Lunella
runners.spotlight: Hooded when third of three on her debut at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in June and ran to a similar level when second of four at Lingfield (1m4f, good to firm) four weeks ago; now switches to the AW and she may yet do better.
runners.comment: Ran to a similar level in both starts (1m2f/1m4f); now switches to the AW; may do better

runners.name: It Would Be You
runners.spotlight: Well on top at the finish in a Catterick bumper (good) in March and made good late progress to finish fifth of 20 in a Grade 2 at Aintree (2m1f, good to soft) the following month; interesting contender now switching to the Flat on her first start for 125 days with yard continuing in fine form.
runners.comment: Last seen keeping on into fifth in a Grade 2 bumper at Aintree in April; Flat debut

runners.name: Ladykirk
runners.spotlight: Promising second on her debut at Yarmouth last October and reappeared with an 8l fifth of ten at Sandown (1m2f, good) in a race won by the subsequent Musidora runner-up; ran to a similar level when fifth of six at Haydock (1m2f, soft) in May when last seen and leaves the impression this longer trip will suit.
runners.comment: Showed ability in all three starts (1m/1m2f); off since May; step up in trip should suit

runners.name: Arrivera
runners.spotlight: Beat only one rival home on her debut at Southwell (1m, AW) in January but she built on that when upped to 1m2f at Lingfield in June, finishing second of 13 behind the odds-on favourite; enough in her pedigree to suggest she'll stay this longer trip; considered.
runners.comment: Showed more when runner-up over 1m2f at Lingfield in June; steps up in trip; considered

races.race_name: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Cogitate
runners.spotlight: Dual winner (7f/1m) who has posted some good efforts at this track, including when runner-up over this C&D in March off a 4lb higher mark; two solid runs since joining this stable and has to be considered with first-time visor replacing cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Has posted some good efforts at this track; two solid runs for this yard; first-time visor

runners.name: Sea Founder
runners.spotlight: Three wins include one here (1m) in April off a 2lb lower mark; below that level on turf in two starts since and drops back to 7f for the first time since his debut, which would be a concern.
runners.comment: Won over 1m here in April off 2lb lower; drops back to 7f for the first time since debut

runners.name: Dapper Guest
runners.spotlight: Three wins last year, two on the AW (2-4 on sand); good fourth of ten at Newmarket (7f, good) in June but he's been below his best in two starts since; may do better returned to this surface.
runners.comment: 2-4 on the AW; fourth at Newmarket in June but below his best in two starts since

runners.name: Flag Of St George
runners.spotlight: 0-9 on the AW but he has gone close on two occasions, including when beaten a head at Lingfield (7f) in December; below his best on his next two outings and was last of seven at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last month; needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: 0-9 on the AW but has gone close on two occasions; last of seven on turf in July

runners.name: Peter The Wolf
runners.spotlight: Won a soft-ground 6f maiden at Chepstow last September but he's struggled in four handicaps since, most recently when fading inside the final furlong over this trip at Southwell two weeks ago; others preferred.
runners.comment: Struggled in four handicaps since winning a Chepstow maiden over 6f last September

runners.name: Arctician
runners.spotlight: Can lead; all eight wins on the AW, five over this C&D; faded into midfield having been drawn wide here in May and soft ground can be given as an excuse for failing to beat a rival at Goodwood (1m) two months ago; could go well back on this surface.
runners.comment: Five-time C&D winner; excuses for his last two efforts and could go well back on the AW

runners.name: Eminency
runners.spotlight: Four wins from 37 starts, the most recent at Chelmsford (7f, AW) in December; got behind early at Southwell last time after short of room leaving the stalls but then kept on into seventh; each-way contender with refitted cheekpieces replacing regular hood.
runners.comment: Kept on into 7th on Southwell AW latest; refitted cheekpieces replace regular hood

runners.name: Brosay
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner (5f/6f) but he's 0-8 since joining this stable; below his best in recent starts but now drops down in grade, albeit with stamina to prove for this longer trip; others more persuasive.
runners.comment: Four-time winner but 0-8 for this stable; has stamina to prove on his first try over 7f

runners.name: Orchid
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f AW winner, most recently at Wolverhampton last April off a 4lb higher mark; well beaten on turf on her first two outings this year but she did run respectably on the AW 12 days ago; cheekpieces added; suspicion she may be at her best over 6f.
runners.comment: Dual 6f AW winner; ran respectably over 7f last time but may be better over a bit shorter

runners.name: Nezeeh
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner on turf but 0-11 on the AW; has struggled since winning at Bellewstown (5f, soft) last October and was always behind on his stable debut at Lingfield (5f, AW) last month; steps back up in trip; best watched.
runners.comment: 0-11 on AW; struggled since winning on soft ground last October, including on yard debut

runners.name: Percy's Lad
runners.spotlight: All six wins have been on turf, the most recent at Chester (7.5f, good to firm) in May 2024 off a 9lb higher mark than today's; back to form when a front-running second here over 1m in June; below his best at Chester 32 days ago but he has a handy draw and is capable of bouncing back.
runners.comment: Six-time turf winner but runner-up here over 1m two starts ago; below his best last time

runners.name: Longlai
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner over 1m; unable to kick on from his stable debut last year but he did run okay when fourth at Newmarket (7f, good) on reappearance in June; may improve on that first outing in 226 days.
runners.comment: Dual course winner over 1m; ran okay over this trip on his reappearance at Newmarket

races.race_name: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Wild Nature
runners.spotlight: Well held in three turf handicaps (Class 3) this season but he's 2-3 on AW and his last win was off just 1lb higher over C&D last November; with another new yard (changed hands for £16,000) but it wouldn't be a surprise if he made a bold bid back on Polytrack.
runners.comment: Record of 2-3 on AW and he needs a close look back in this sphere for new yard

runners.name: Berry Clever
runners.spotlight: His three AW wins have all been at Kempton including two over C&D; made the breakthrough on turf at Yarmouth in May and he's run respectably there in his last two starts; now goes back up in grade but he's not ruled out back on Polytrack.
runners.comment: Triple course winner who has been in good form on turf this summer; not ruled out

runners.name: Chalk Mountain
runners.spotlight: Seven-time AW winner and the latest three have been over C&D; has mixed record for new trainer this season but he was runner-up at Southwell last time and remains feasibly treated off only 1lb higher than for his win here in May; key player.
runners.comment: AW specialist who is a triple C&D winner and was runner-up at Southwell latest; key player

runners.name: Kitaro Kich
runners.spotlight: 5-21 on AW compared to 0-11 on grass; struggled off his lower turf mark at Epsom four weeks ago but he had reappeared with a creditable effort here previously and his last success was over C&D; could be dangerous if he gets a good pace and some luck.
runners.comment: All five wins have been on AW and has claims if he gets a good pace back on Polytrack
runners.owner: J Machale, S Tucker & S Jewell

runners.name: Philanthropist
runners.spotlight: Won in first-time cheekpieces at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) in April; reached the frame in next two starts but his form nosedived in a big field at Ascot (last of 16) last time; has a bit to prove after that but this is a big drop back in grade and he's a player if he can bounce back.
runners.comment: Finished last at Ascot but that was a Class 2 and he's a player if he can bounce back

runners.name: Lady Mariko
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with a 6f win here in April but she's not come close to that form since and was tailed off at Newmarket last month; now only 1lb higher than for her last success but she needs a big turnaround.
runners.comment: Reappeared with a win here in April but she's struggled since; passed over

runners.name: How Impressive
runners.spotlight: Seven-time AW winner who was runner-up over C&D in March but has lost his way with heavy defeats in his last three runs; has a lot to prove and he needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in March but he's lost his way since and has a lot to prove

runners.name: Kiniro
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 6f win at Lingfield (Polytrack) for Harry Charlton; his best effort in four runs for current yard was a second at Newbury in June but he's not easy to predict and was disappointing at Windsor last time; risks attached.
runners.comment: Has mixed record for current yard and was down the field at Windsor latest; risks attached

runners.name: Bridget's View
runners.spotlight: Emphatic winner off 2lb lower at Southwell (1m, AW) last December but she's been disappointing since and was beaten 14l at Newmarket (last of six) in June; has questions to answer and she needs a major revival after a short break; tongue-tie returns with first-time hood.
runners.comment: Out of sorts of late and needs major revival; tongue-tie returns with first-time hood

runners.name: Metal Merchant
runners.spotlight: His last win was in April 2024 but he hasn't been with John Butler for long and he showed signs of a revival when fourth at Newcastle (1m, AW) last month; has claims if he can build on that and he should be fine back at this trip.
runners.comment: Well treated on old form and he showed signs of a revival at Newcastle latest; in the mix

runners.name: Racingbreaks Ryder
runners.spotlight: Added to his five turf wins when making all to beat 13 rivals at Newcastle (1m, Tapeta) in June; 5lb higher from wide draw here but he still looks on a workable mark and is lightly raced on AW; respected back in trip.
runners.comment: Made all when beating 13 rivals at Newcastle last time and he's respected back in trip
runners.owner: Cottier, Racing Breaks & Old Gold Racing

races.race_name: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)

runners.name: Kindest Nation
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner over 7f, the most recent coming on the AW at Newcastle last November; never featured after missing the break at Chester (7f, good to soft) two months ago and needs to take a big step forward from that reappearance.
runners.comment: Four-time winner over 7f; never featured after missing the break at Chester on her return

runners.name: Metallo
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 19 starts came in a Salisbury maiden on his second start in 2023; has posted a couple of good efforts for this stable, including when beaten a neck at Lingfield (1m2f, AW; first-time hood)  in February; cheekpieces are quickly discarded after a poor run here over 1m3f latest.
runners.comment: 1-19; went close on his stable debut in February; poor run latest; cheekpieces discarded

runners.name: Grey Soul
runners.spotlight: Built on his stable debut when winning in first-time cheekpieces at Ffos Las (1m, good to soft) in June and followed up next time over that same C&D, taking his record in headgear to 3-3 (won in first-time blinkers for Roger Varian); 3lb higher but respected on his return to the AW.
runners.comment: Took his record in headgear to 3-3 when winning at Ffos Las in June; now 3lb higher

runners.name: I Am Me
runners.spotlight: Got up late to win a 0-70 over this C&D in April off a 3lb lower mark but he was disappointing here in June following a break; needs to bounce back after two months off.
runners.comment: Got up late to win over C&D in April but disappointing here in June; absent since

runners.name: Warrior Mode
runners.spotlight: Winning debut on AW at Wolverhampton (7f) last March but was well held in two handicaps later; however, he posted a solid effort when third at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) on reappearance, having undergone wind/gelding operations, and should come on for that; this return to 1m could suit.
runners.comment: Made a winning debut at Wolverhampton last year; solid effort on his return at Newmarket

runners.name: Stardancer
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two AW novice events in 2024 and 2025, and got off the mark at the seventh attempt when landing a handicap at Chepstow (1m, good to firm) in June; he's lightly raced and unexposed over this trip, so could have more to offer.
runners.comment: Off the mark at the seventh attempt when winning at Chepstow in June; still lightly raced

runners.name: Beauty By My Side
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner (7f/1m), most recently at Chelmsford (first-time cheekpieces) in October but she's mostly struggled since, including at Ascot last time after a five-month break; dropped another 2lb.
runners.comment: Mostly struggled since winning over 1m at Chelmsford last October; dropped another 2lb

runners.name: Cotswold Cottage
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner on turf (1m1f-11.5f), including when making all at Haydock (good to soft) last September; drops back in trip on her first start since and she may well need the outing.
runners.comment: Gained her third success when making all at Haydock last September; has been off since

runners.name: Foreseen
runners.spotlight: Made all in a 0-95 at Lingfield (7.5f, good to firm) in May off a 3lb lower mark than today's but he did too much too soon over 1m2f at Sandown two months ago; dropping back in trip should suit this C&D winner.
runners.comment: C&D winner who did too much too soon over 1m2f at Sandown last time; drops back in trip

runners.name: Lili Marleen
runners.spotlight: 1m AW winner in France last December but she finished last and unseated at the start on her next two outings, then down the field over hurdles in April; has pulled up and finished last of nine in two starts since joining Jack Jones; others preferred.
runners.comment: 1m AW winner in France last year; pulled up and finished last in two starts for Jack Jones

races.race_name: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)

runners.name: Gallant
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner who finished well to snatch third in a Class 4 handicap at Ascot (7f, good to firm) 19 days ago; looks interesting off 1lb lower here and he is tactically versatile.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner who was good third off 1lb higher at Ascot last time; shortlisted

runners.name: Final Night
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been over C&D and latest was in March; record of 0-9 on turf but he returned to form with a close second in a big field at York last time; only 1lb higher back on Polytrack and he should get a decent tow into this race; respected.
runners.comment: All four wins have been over C&D; went close at York latest and he's respected back on AW

runners.name: Rogue Allegiance
runners.spotlight: Resurgent 4yo who has form figures of 23221 since April and beat a clear second when scoring at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) last month on his second run for James Owen; a 4lb rise for that success looks fair and he's a big player back on AW.
runners.comment: Resurgent 4yo who has form figures of 23221 since April; big player back on AW

runners.name: Sovereign View
runners.spotlight: 3yo who ended last season with a Newcastle win (1m, AW) and has run well in three of his four starts this season including when fourth of 14 at Newcastle (cheekpieces added) last month; still has low mileage and he should be in the mix again.
runners.comment: 3yo who was creditable fourth at Newcastle (1m) latest and he should be in the mix again

runners.name: Dumuji
runners.spotlight: Won here (7f, AW) last November on sole 2yo start; started his handicap career with a fair fifth at Windsor (1m, good to firm) in May and he had a tough assignment in Class 3 at Glorious Goodwood last time; still unexposed and he's one to keep an eye on back in calmer waters.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo who still has potential and he's one to keep an eye on back in calmer waters

runners.name: Man Of Desert
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden but he ran well with a tongue-tie added when runner-up at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago; this is a deeper race but he could go well again off the same mark.
runners.comment: 0-12 but was runner-up at Yarmouth last time and he's in the mix

runners.name: City Of Kings
runners.spotlight: Missed more than three years after a few starts for Charlie Appleby and he's struggled in both runs for new yard this summer; still unexposed but he needs a major revival on Polytrack debut.
runners.comment: Missed more than three years before struggling in both runs for new yard this summer

runners.name: Lieutenant Kije
runners.spotlight: Showed clear promise in novice/maiden events last summer but he was well held in a nursery here (7f) in his final 2yo run; still early days but he needs improvement upped to 1m on return for new yard.
runners.comment: Still early days but he needs improvement upped to 1m after 287 days off

runners.name: San Juanito
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins for former stable but he's struggled in his last five runs and was tailed off over C&D (80-1) last time; continues to drop down the weights but he has a lot to prove.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner but he's struggled in last five runs and has a lot to prove

races.race_name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Forever Penywern
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over hurdles in May and took his record to 2-2 on the AW when making all at Southwell (1m3f, AW) last month, pulling clear with one who has since finished second in a Listed race; has now won his last three starts on the Flat and a 6lb rise may not be enough to prevent a bold bid.
runners.comment: Made it 2-2 on the AW when winning at Southwell last time and that form has been franked

runners.name: Dust Cover
runners.spotlight: Has won three times, including here over 1m3f in February off a mark 5lb lower than today's, and he was beaten only a nose by Must Believe here in May; didn't quite get home here over 2m last month and will be suited by this drop back in trip; has claims.
runners.comment: Three wins including one here over 1m3f; didn't quite get home over 2m here last month

runners.name: The Green Mile
runners.spotlight: Chepstow winner in May over 1m2f and made a winning AW debut here over 1m3f in June (had the hood removed); raised 6lb for that success but he should have no problem with the extra furlong and has good claims.
runners.comment: Made a winning AW debut here over 1m3f in June; raised 6lb for that but has good claims

runners.name: Kokbastau
runners.spotlight: Stepped forward from his debut when third of six at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) last month and built on that when winning over 1m4f at Southwell two weeks ago; looks the type to continue to progress and he's of obvious interest on his handicap debut.
runners.comment: Took another step forward when winning over 1m4f at Southwell; can continue to progress

runners.name: Bulletin
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort who has yet to be out of the first four in 17 starts; his two wins including one here over 1m3f last August and he was beaten only 2l over C&D last month; should continue to give his running.
runners.comment: Yet to finish out of the first four in 17 starts; two wins include one here over 1m3f

runners.name: Son Of Man
runners.spotlight: Landed a competitive handicap at Lingfield (1m4f, AW) in April before being placed on his next two starts, but he was tailed off over this C&D in May; a 77-day break may have done him some good and he could bounce back.
runners.comment: Won at Lingfield in April but was tailed off over this C&D in May; has been off since

runners.name: Must Believe
runners.spotlight: Held on to beat Dust Cover by a nose here over 1m3f on his stable debut in May before a disappointing run at Goodwood (1m4f, good to soft), taking his record on turf to 0-5; could bounce back returned to this surface.
runners.comment: Beat Dust Cover by a nose here on his stable debut in May; lesser run on turf last time

runners.name: Mathematician
runners.spotlight: Dual winner for Roger Varian for 2023, including when pulling clear here over 1m3f; was returning from a huge absence when beating only one rival home here in a race won by The Green Mile in June and needs to leave that well behind.
runners.comment: Dual winner for Roger Varian; beat only one rival home here after a huge absence last time

runners.name: Classical Allusion
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut at Southwell (1m4f, AW) last September and finished a 2l second of eight behind Constitution Hill in a novice over this C&D in March; however, he didn't get home when sent off favourite on his handicap debut at Newbury (2m) and was tailed off at Ascot (1m4f) in May; returning to the AW may help.
runners.comment: Bumped into Constitution Hill over C&D in March but disappointing in two handicaps since

runners.name: Galaxy Star
runners.spotlight: Bumper winning who made a successful debut in this sphere in a 1m3f maiden here in March before running well in a 1m4f Listed event; however, she was well held on her handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good) in June and now returns to the AW with better needed.
runners.comment: Made a winning Flat debut here in March but well held on her handicap debut last time

runners.name: Duc De Kent
runners.spotlight: French turf/AW winner (7.5f/1m2f) in 2023; yet to be placed for this stable but he almost certainly needed his first start for 806 days when sixth of seven at Chester (1m2f, good) last time; dropped another 3lb and he may take a step forward.
runners.comment: Almost certainly needed his first start for 806 days when sixth of seven at Chester latest

runners.name: Cumulonimbus
runners.spotlight: Progressive for Charlie Fellowes, winning five times on turf (1m2f/1m4f); however, he's been well beaten in four starts for this stable and has been absent for another 410 days; best watched.
runners.comment: Well beaten in four starts for this stable and has been absent for 410 days; best watched

races.race_name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap

runners.name: Star Time
runners.spotlight: Dual winner (1m2f/1m4f; good to firm/AW); respectable fifth of ten here over 1m3f in May on his first start for 433 days but he was below his best at Nottingham (1m2f, good) in June; needs to bounce back on his first start since.
runners.comment: Respectable fifth here over 1m3f in May but below his best on turf 70 days ago; off since

runners.name: Naasma
runners.spotlight: Course winner over 2m in October 2024 but her last three wins have been at Windsor over 11.5f; well held in three starts this year, albeit she wasn't helped by being caught wide at Lingfield last month.
runners.comment: Course winner over 2m in 2024; well held in three starts this year; others stronger

runners.name: Maywedance
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner, most recently in May off a 3lb higher mark than today's; has finished third in two starts since, including here last month, and once again holds solid claims.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner who has finished third on her last two starts; holds solid claims

runners.name: Backer Bilk
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 15 starts came at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) last February when trained by Jim & Suzi Best; 0-5 for his previous stable (Flat/hurdles) and has a hood applied on his first outing for Luke Dace.
runners.comment: 0-5 for his previous stable and has the hood applied on his first start for Luke Dace

runners.name: Crooked Path
runners.spotlight: 0-6 on the Flat but he won a maiden hurdle at Tramore in April on his final start for Denis Hogan; has since been purchased for £26,000 and makes his stable/AW debut for a yard that does well with new recruits; market should be informative.
runners.comment: Won a maiden hurdle at Tramore in April; interesting contender on his stable/AW debut

runners.name: Solanna
runners.spotlight: Five-time course winner (1m-1m3f) who gained his third success on turf when winning under Billy Loughnane at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) in June; can't be dismissed back on the AW off this 2lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Five-time course winner; up 2lb for his Ffos Las win; can't be dismissed back on the AW

runners.name: Maestro Del Mar
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in the Italian St Leger on heavy ground on his final start for his previous yard and he didn't seem to get home over 1m6f at Goodwood on his stable debut in June; that was his first start for 209 days and he may be capable of better now dropping back in trip for his handicap debut.
runners.comment: Didn't seem to get home over 1m6f at Goodwood on his stable debut; drops back in trip

runners.name: Eljowhary
runners.spotlight: Showed ability on his first three starts (7f/1m) but he failed to beat a rival home on his handicap debut at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW; reported to have lost his action) in June; has since left Roger Varian having been bought for 12,000gns and has the hood removed for his yard debut.
runners.comment: Has left Roger Varian since failing to beat a rival home on his handicap debut; hood off

runners.name: Imperial Decision
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who was narrowly beaten on his handicap debut at Lingfield (1m4f, AW) in February before another good effort here next time; however, he was tailed off at the former track in April and has been off since.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden and he was tailed off at Lingfield in April; has been off since

runners.name: Roland Garros
runners.spotlight: Made all at Cattrick (1m4f, good) in April off a mark 3lb lower than today's and he caught the eye finishing strongly into third here over 2m a week ago; the drop back in trip doesn't look an obvious plus on that evidence but has to be respected.
runners.comment: Caught the eye finishing strongly into third here over 2m last week; drops back in trip

races.race_name: Faucets The Bathroom Specialists Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Eskimo Pie
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo; has regressed this season and is now 0-8 but was only beaten about 3l when dropped back to 6f for 0-85 Newmarket handicap (good to firm) in June and has good chance at the weights here.
runners.comment: Has regressed this year but wasn't beaten far in 0-85 handicap last time; good form chance

runners.name: Mystic Veil
runners.spotlight: £130,000 yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to winners No Half Measures (5f/6f including 2yo/Group 1 July Cup; RPR 119) and Trilby (5f/6f; 91); dam placed 7f AW 2yo (68), half-sister to 8.6f-1m4f winner Dubai Bounty (dam of 5f Group 3 winner Kachy); doesn't need to be anything special to pose a threat on debut.
runners.comment: £130,000 yearling; half-sister to July Cup winner No Half Measures; interesting on debut

runners.name: Livvys Edge
runners.spotlight: Showed her inexperience and made a low-key debut when sixth of seven here (5f, good) last month; upped in trip today.
runners.comment: Showed her inexperience and made a low-key debut over 5f here last month
runners.owner: Int Plywood (lmporters) Ltd And C Mason

runners.name: Mollstar
runners.spotlight: Absent since disappointing nursery debut in December (7f, AW) but displayed improvement when close third in Wolverhampton novice (6f, AW) in November and will play a major role if in similar form here.
runners.comment: Off since disappointing nursery debut in December but was placed in AW novice in November

races.race_name: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap

runners.name: The Coffee Pod
runners.spotlight: No longer the force of old but was close third off today's career-low mark here (6f, good) eight days ago; eased in grade today and can handle the drop back to 5f; must be considered.
runners.comment: Close third off this career-low mark here (6f) last week; eased in grade; one to consider

runners.name: Portacloy
runners.spotlight: Raced exclusively over 6f during seven-race career; soundly beaten in all four handicaps since winning AW maiden in September; drops in trip with tongue-tie added here; needs to get career back on track.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in all four handicaps since 6f AW maiden win; drops in trip here

runners.name: Dark Sun
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent mare who belatedly opened her account at Bath (5f, good) in June, her 19th start; also ran well when close third at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) on latest outing; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Largely consistent mare who won over 5f in June and also ran well over 6f on latest outing

runners.name: Miracleoftheandes
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo; displayed improvement when second in Nottingham novice on last month's seasonal debut but was safely held when fifth of seven in subsequent Lingfield handicap (also 5f good to firm) and will clearly need to fare better here.
runners.comment: Safely held when fifth of seven on recent handicap debut at Lingfield; improvement needed

runners.name: Miss Gold
runners.spotlight: Struggled on all three starts this season, most recently when last of nine in basement-grade Lingfield classified (1m, AW) last month; can't be recommended on this return to sprinting.
runners.comment: Struggled in 1m classified race last month; makes no appeal on return to sprinting

runners.name: Sheik Yerbouti
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on first two outings but belied 200-1 odds when placed in Wolverhampton maiden (5f, AW) in June and it wil be interesting to see whether he can build on that performance on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Well beaten on first two starts but ws placed at huge odds in AW maiden last time

runners.name: Little Jaybee
runners.spotlight: Out of form for Tom Ward this season (four runs) and was just a respectable third of five for new stable at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) last week; visor removed after one use; needs to up her game.
runners.comment: Just a respectable third of five on recent stable debut; needs to up her game
runners.owner: Mrs A L Lofts & Mrs Nicky Scott Knight

runners.name: Happier
runners.spotlight: Came good for current stable at seventh attempt, with emphatic 5f AW win 12 days ago; will be fine back on turf and recent 5lb rise ought to be manageable; respected.
runners.comment: Emphatic winner on AW last week; also suited by turf and recent 5lb rise is manageable

races.race_name: Meyer Timber EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Narrjoo
runners.spotlight: Out of a well-connected mare and cost 200,000gns at a breeze-up; runner-up in what looked a fairly good Doncaster novice (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; leading contender.
runners.comment: Runner-up in what looked a fairly good Doncaster novice (7f) three weeks ago

runners.name: Grand Havana
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam 5f 2yo winner (RPR 90), sister to Group-placed 6f 2yo winner Squash, half-sister to 6f/7f winner Mount Mogan; stable not prolific with first-time-out 2yos.
runners.comment: Out of a useful 5f 2yo winner; stable not prolific with first-time-out 2yo winners

runners.name: Drum Bay
runners.spotlight: Out of a well-connected Listed winner; showed her inexperience and also significant promise when keeping on to take second behind a next-time-out winner at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month; respected.
runners.comment: Kept on to take second behind a next-time-out winner on debut (7f, AW); respected

runners.name: Engraved
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Crack Of Light (9.4f/1m4f including Listed; RPR 101) and Cet Horizon (1m 2yo; 83); dam 11.6f-1m4f winner (94), closely related to 1m4f Group 2 winner Frankly Darling; stable has only occasional 2yo debut winners.
runners.comment: 200,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; out of a useful middle-distance winner; market may guide

runners.name: World Star
runners.spotlight: 135,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; sixth foal; half-brother to four winners including Likedbymike (Listed-placed 5f 2yo/6f; RPR 104); dam placed 6f 2yo (54); worth a glance in the betting but has good standard to reach on debut.
runners.comment: 135,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; worth a market check but has good standard to reach

runners.name: Isabella De Vega
runners.spotlight: Has excellent pedigree and cost 350,000gns as a yearling; displayed clear promise on recent debut at Thirsk (7f, good to firm), keeping on strongly for third, and ought to build on that performance here.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly who kept on strongly for third on recent debut at Thirsk (7f)

runners.name: Q T Boy
runners.spotlight: Finished last in two 6f Windsor novices races last month and can't be recommended here.
runners.comment: Finished last in two 6f Windsor novices races last month and can't be recommended here

races.race_name: Dandara Homes Handicap

runners.name: Nammos
runners.spotlight: Scored at Bath (1m, firm) on stable debut in May and has remained in pretty good form since; still on a workable mark; ought to be on the premises.
runners.comment: Scored at Bath (1m) on stable debut in May and has remained in pretty good form since

runners.name: King Of The Dance
runners.spotlight: Admirably consistent 7yo who chased home Angel's Call in 7.3f classified race here in June and was third over C&D in that grade a fortnight ago; probably in the mix again.
runners.comment: Admirably consistent 7yo who was third in C&D classified a fortnight ago; in the mix

runners.name: Rival
runners.spotlight: Safely held on all three starts since returning from nine-month absence in June and remains without a win since 2022; stable's other runner Nammos has less to prove.
runners.comment: Safely held on all three starts since returning from absence in June; last won in 2022

runners.name: Angel's Call
runners.spotlight: Arrested decline on last two outings, more recently when beating King Of The Dance to win 7.3f classified race here (good) six weeks ago; has more on his plate in this handicap but still considered.
runners.comment: Won 7.3f classified here on latest outing; this is a bit tougher; still considered

runners.name: Ivat Ghia
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who ran on well from the rear to take second on handicap debut at Leicester (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago; competes off same mark here and could still have potential; respected.
runners.comment: Ran on well from the rear for second on handicap debut at Leicester last month; respected

runners.name: Uncle Albert
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 5yo who gained sole career win in spring 2024; down the field on both starts for new stable in June, the latter over C&D, and needs to turn things around; blinkers removed; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Down the field on both starts for new stable in June, the latter over C&D; revival needed

runners.name: Big Moonrise
runners.spotlight: Showed nothing more than minor promise in his three qualifying races (all 7f) but makes his handicap debut from a workable mark and improvement is possible.
runners.comment: Yet to show anything more than minor promise but has lowly opening handicap mark

runners.name: Change Of Fortune
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D last summer but that remains his only success from 38 starts, and he was well beaten over 1m2f on latest outing two months ago; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Won over C&D last summer but has poor strike-rate and was well beaten last time

runners.name: Kev
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who became disappointing for Tom Ward, signing off for him with heavy defeat in first-time blinkers in May; goes without headgear on this stable debut; needs to have been reinvigorated by new regime.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden who became disappointing for Tom Ward; now with new stable

runners.name: Oviedo
runners.spotlight: Very useful over middle distances in his prime but was badly out of sorts on AW during the winter and returned from break with disappointing 7f turf run in May; cheekpieces removed after one use; could be considered only if lively in the betting.
runners.comment: Has been in the doldrums for a good while; considered only if lively in the betting

races.race_name: Golwg Gwendraeth 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)

runners.name: John Harrison
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; returned from break with two good efforts this summer, latterly when third of five at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) last month; should be fine over today's longer trip; likely contender.
runners.comment: Returned from break with two good efforts this summer (1m/1m2f); likely contender

runners.name: Royal Bodyguard
runners.spotlight: Sometimes races a bit too freely but ran well before fading into fourth of ten at Newmarket (1m, good) in June and is now 3lb lower than when placed at Windsor (1m, good to firm) in May; good chance.
runners.comment: Ran well at Newmarket in June and now 3lb lower than when placed at Windsor in May

runners.name: Port Louis
runners.spotlight: Belied 50-1 odds when second of 22 at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) in March but this quirky customer has a very mixed record this year and spoiled his chance by pulling far too hard on his latest outing; others are much less risky.
runners.comment: Has the ability to feature but this quirky customer has a very mixed record this year

runners.name: Next Guilian
runners.spotlight: Placed on soft ground in Germany in the autumn and also showed promise on last two of three British starts this year; remains unexposed; no surprise if he features on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Showed promise on last two British starts; could have a say on handicap debut

runners.name: Brave New World
runners.spotlight: Cut little ice in three 7f novice races in April-July and is not obviously well treated for this handicap debut but improvement is possible over the longer trip.
runners.comment: Cut little ice in three 7f novice races; improvement needed on handicap debut

runners.name: The Stone Power
runners.spotlight: Bettered low-key handicap debut when fourth at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in June; pulled up there last month (jockey felt something was amiss) but may still have a bigger run in him if all goes to plan here.
runners.comment: Pulled up (something amiss) last time but can still build upon earlier AW fourth

races.race_name: Dress For The Occasions Handicap

runners.name: A Daughters Love
runners.spotlight: Went to a whole new level when drawing 10l clear over C&D (good) eight days ago, her third win of the year; that race developed into a stamina test and the form is treated with a degree of caution but, nevertheless, she commands respect under a 6lb penalty.
runners.comment: Progressive filly who carries 6lb penalty for last week's wide-margin C&D win; respected

runners.name: Belle Of Kt
runners.spotlight: Back in prime form with two wins in July, the latter by a nose in small field at Bath (1m6f, good to firm); only 1lb higher here and can cope with the drop back in trip; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Back in prime form with two wins in July, the latter by a nose in small field at Bath

runners.name: Meet Me In Meraki
runners.spotlight: Placed here (1m2f, good) in June, after a break, and not discredited when second of four over C&D (good) last month; remains well handicapped on some of his winter AW form and can make his presence felt again.
runners.comment: Returned from break with two good efforts here (1m2f/1m4f) and remains well handicapped
runners.owner: Spiers & Hartwell Ltd & Mrs E Evans

runners.name: Bulldog Spirit
runners.spotlight: Regressive 6yo who managed only third of four over C&D (good; first-time tongue-tie) last month and is now 0-5 for his new stable this year; cheekpieces (no obvious effect when used twice last season) are given another whirl; revival needed.
runners.comment: Regressive 6yo who is 0-5 for his new stable this season; revival needed

runners.name: Noble Grace
runners.spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles but made winning Flat handicap debut over C&D (good) a fortnight ago, clinging on well to cause a 40-1 surprise; only 2lb higher today and further progress is possible.
runners.comment: Narrowly caused 40-1 surprise over C&D a fortnight ago; still unexposed on the Flat

runners.name: Claytons Kolatonic
runners.spotlight: Safely held over 1m in his first two handicaps; remains unexposed but is not bred to benefit from this hike up in trip and needs significant improvement.
runners.comment: Safely held over 1m in his first two handicaps and not bred for this longer trip
